sql: SELECT MAX(1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) FROM frpm AS f JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.cdscode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.numtsttakr > 0 AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0 AND 1.0 * s.numge1500 / NULLIF(s.numtsttakr, 0) > 0.3

SELECT s.school, s.doctype FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded' AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm AS f2 JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2.cdscode = s2.cdscode WHERE s2.fundingtype = 'Locally funded') ORDER BY s.cdscode NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(1.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 6) FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.soc = '66' AND NOT f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NULL AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST, s.cdscode NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM schools WHERE statustype = 'Merged' AND county = 'Orange'

SELECT sc.mailstreet, sc.school FROM satscores AS sat JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.rtype = 'S' AND NOT sat.avgscrmath IS NULL ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath DESC NULLS LAST, sat.cds NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT COUNT(t2.school) FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.county = 'Los Angeles' AND t2.charter = 0 AND CASE WHEN (t1."Free Meal Count (K-12)") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t1."Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(t1."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) < 0.18

SELECT t2.school, t1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100 / NULLIF(t1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.county = 'Los Angeles' AND t2.gsserved = 'K-9'
SELECT t1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / NULLIF(t1."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), t1."District Code" FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.admfname1 = 'Alusine'

WITH matched AS (SELECT admemail1, admemail2, admemail3 FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Bernardino' AND city = 'San Bernardino' AND doctype = 'Unified School District' AND soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)' AND opendate >= '2009-01-01' AND opendate < '2011-01-01') SELECT admemail1 AS email FROM matched WHERE NOT admemail1 IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(admemail1 AS TEXT)) <> '' UNION SELECT admemail2 AS email FROM matched WHERE NOT admemail2 IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(admemail2 AS TEXT)) <> '' UNION SELECT admemail3 AS email FROM matched WHERE NOT admemail3 IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(admemail3 AS TEXT)) <> '' ORDER BY email NULLS FIRST

SELECT t1.ncesschool FROM schools AS t1 INNER JOIN frpm AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE CASE WHEN (t2.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END IN (1751010130583, 1612910137588, 1611760134270) AND t2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (SELECT MAX(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm AS f WHERE CASE WHEN (f.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((f.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END IN (1751010130583, 1612910137588, 1611760134270))

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sc.numtsttakr, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school FROM schools AS s LEFT JOIN satscores AS sc ON sc.cds = s.cdscode WHERE CASE WHEN (s.charternum) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.charternum) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 756 AND s.mailcity = 'San Diego'

WITH cohort AS (SELECT s.school AS school_name, s.gsserved AS grade_span_served, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(s.gsserved AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('-' IN s.gsserved || '-') - 1) = 'P' THEN -1 WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(s.gsserved AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('-' IN s.gsserved || '-') - 1) = 'K' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(s.gsserved AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('-' IN s.gsserved || '-') - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(s.gsserved AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('-' IN s.gsserved || '-') - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END END AS start_rank FROM schools AS s LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON s.cdscode = t.cds WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360' AND s.statustype = 'Active' AND CAST(s.gsserved AS TEXT) LIKE '%12' AND COALESCE(t.numtsttakr, 0) = 0) SELECT school_name, grade_span_served FROM cohort WHERE start_rank = (SELECT MIN(start_rank) FROM cohort) ORDER BY school_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet FROM satscores AS t JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education' AND NOT t.sname IS NULL AND NOT t.avgscrread IS NULL AND t.avgscrread = (SELECT MAX(t2.avgscrread) FROM satscores AS t2 JOIN schools AS s2 ON t2.cds = s2.cdscode WHERE s2.doctype = 'State Board of Education' AND NOT t2.sname IS NULL AND NOT t2.avgscrread IS NULL)

SELECT s.city FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1611920113902 AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND s.county = 'Alameda' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND s.eilcode = 'HS'

SELECT t2.school AS school, t2.city AS city FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t1."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2' AND t2.eilcode = 'HS' AND CASE WHEN (t1."Low Grade") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t1."Low Grade") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END > 9 ORDER BY t2.school NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.school AS school_name, s.phone AS phone FROM satscores AS t INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.doctype = 'Statewide Benefit Charter' AND t.rtype = 'S' AND t.numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(t2.numge1500) FROM satscores AS t2 INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON t2.cds = s2.cdscode WHERE s2.doctype = 'Statewide Benefit Charter' AND t2.rtype = 'S')

SELECT t1.avgscrmath AS average_math_score, t1.numtsttakr AS number_of_test_takers FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN frpm AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode WHERE CASE WHEN (t1.cds) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t1.cds) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1611190130609 AND t2."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' AND NOT sname IS NULL AND numtsttakr > (SELECT numtsttakr FROM satscores WHERE CASE WHEN (cds) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((cds) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 7618040730051)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.mailcity = 'San Francisco' AND t2.doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND (t1.avgscrread + t1.avgscrmath + t1.avgscrwrite) >= 1500

SELECT t1."Low Grade" AS lowest_grade FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.ncesdist = '0632640' ORDER BY (t1."Low Grade" = 'P') DESC NULLS LAST, (t1."Low Grade" = 'K') DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN (t1."Low Grade") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t1."Low Grade") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END NULLS FIRST, t1."Low Grade" NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH scope AS (SELECT cdscode, district, admfname1 AS fn FROM schools WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND NOT admfname1 IS NULL UNION SELECT cdscode, district, admfname2 FROM schools WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND NOT admfname2 IS NULL UNION SELECT cdscode, district, admfname3 FROM schools WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND NOT admfname3 IS NULL), ranked AS (SELECT fn, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS schools_run FROM scope GROUP BY fn ORDER BY schools_run DESC NULLS LAST, fn ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 2), districts AS (SELECT DISTINCT district FROM schools WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')) SELECT d.district AS district_name, r.fn AS first_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM scope AS s WHERE s.district = d.district AND s.fn = r.fn) AS school_count FROM districts AS d CROSS JOIN ranked AS r ORDER BY d.district NULLS FIRST, r.fn NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(t1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0.0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.cdscode), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_frpm_ages_5_17 FROM schools AS t2 LEFT JOIN frpm AS t1 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE CAST(t2.soctype AS TEXT) LIKE '%Youth Authority%'

SELECT s.school, s.eilname FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND f."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1612590136051

SELECT t2.school, t2.admemail1 FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.doctype = 'State Board of Education' AND t1.rtype = 'S' AND t1.numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(t3.numge1500) FROM satscores AS t3 INNER JOIN schools AS t4 ON t3.cds = t4.cdscode WHERE t4.doctype = 'State Board of Education' AND t3.rtype = 'S')

SELECT t1."School Type", t1."School Name", t2.latitude FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE (CAST(t1."School Type" AS TEXT) LIKE '%Middle%' OR CAST(t1."School Name" AS TEXT) LIKE '%Middle%') AND t2.latitude = (SELECT MAX(t2b.latitude) FROM frpm AS t1b INNER JOIN schools AS t2b ON t1b.cdscode = t2b.cdscode WHERE CAST(t1b."School Type" AS TEXT) LIKE '%Middle%' OR CAST(t1b."School Name" AS TEXT) LIKE '%Middle%')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers FROM schools AS s LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.opendate AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2007' AND (CAST(s.doctype AS TEXT) ILIKE '%school district%' OR CAST(s.doctype AS TEXT) ILIKE '%county office of education%')

SELECT s.fundingtype AS funding_category, COUNT(*) AS operating_charter_schools, SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_k12_enrollment, ROUND(CAST(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_frpm_percentage, ROUND(CAST(AVG(sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_combined_sat FROM schools AS s LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.statustype = 'Active' AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY s.fundingtype ORDER BY funding_category NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.school AS school_name, f."Low Grade" AS starting_grade, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment, COALESCE(t.numtsttakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.doctype = 'State Special Schools' ORDER BY CASE f."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN (f."Low Grade") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((f."Low Grade") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END + 1 END DESC NULLS LAST, f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST, s.school ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode WHERE NOT s.school IS NULL AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND CASE WHEN (f."High Grade") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((f."High Grade") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND COALESCE(t.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type, COUNT(*) AS active_charter_schools, SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_k12_enrollment, SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_students FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)' AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND s.statustype = 'Active' GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS FIRST

WITH j AS (SELECT t2.school AS school, t2.district AS district, t2.county AS county, t1.avgscrwrite AS avgscrwrite FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.statustype = 'Closed' AND NOT t1.avgscrwrite IS NULL AND NOT t1.sname IS NULL) SELECT school, district, county, avgscrwrite FROM j WHERE avgscrwrite = (SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite) FROM j WHERE avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite) FROM j))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_taker_open_high_schools FROM schools AS sc LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.cdscode = s.cds WHERE sc.statustype = 'Active' AND sc.eilname = 'High School' AND COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

WITH targetcounty AS (SELECT "County Name" AS countyname FROM frpm WHERE CASE WHEN (cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1612590125716), cohort AS (SELECT f.cdscode, ROUND(CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS freepct, ROUND(CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS frpmpct, f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charterflag, sd.avgscrread + sd.avgscrmath + sd.avgscrwrite AS satscore FROM frpm AS f JOIN targetcounty AS t ON f."County Name" = t.countyname LEFT JOIN satscores AS sd ON f.cdscode = sd.cds WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700) SELECT (SELECT countyname FROM targetcounty) AS county_name, COUNT(*) AS school_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(freepct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(frpmpct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN charterflag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count, SUM(CASE WHEN charterflag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(satscore) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_sat_score FROM cohort

SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(*)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(*)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(12, 0) AS monthly_average FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(opendate AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1980' AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS pct FROM satscores AS sat JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode WHERE sat.rtype = 'S' AND sat.avgscrmath > 400

SELECT s.school AS school_name, s.county AS county, s.district AS district, s.city AS city, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_frpm, sat.numtsttakr AS num_sat_takers, sat.avgscrread AS avg_reading, sat.avgscrmath AS avg_math, sat.avgscrwrite AS avg_writing, sat.numge1500 AS num_ge_1500 FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode WHERE CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1612590137943

WITH cohort AS (SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name, f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_rate, sc.charter, sc.gsserved, s.avgscrread, s.avgscrmath, s.avgscrwrite FROM frpm AS f LEFT JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.cdscode = f.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.cdscode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND RIGHT(CAST(sc.gsserved AS TEXT), 2) = '12') SELECT school_name, ROUND(CAST(free_rate AS DECIMAL), 4) AS highest_free_meal_rate, CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS is_charter, gsserved AS grades_served, CASE WHEN avgscrread IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS sat_performance FROM cohort WHERE free_rate = (SELECT MAX(f2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f2."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) FROM frpm AS f2 JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.cdscode = f2.cdscode WHERE f2."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND RIGHT(CAST(s2.gsserved AS TEXT), 2) = '12')

WITH benchmark AS (SELECT MAX(t.avgscrmath) AS topmath FROM satscores AS t INNER JOIN schools AS s ON s.cdscode = t.cds WHERE s.statustype = 'Active' AND t.numtsttakr >= 10) SELECT s.school AS "School Name", s.phone AS "Phone Number", s.website AS website, t.avgscrread AS "Average SAT Reading Score", t.avgscrmath AS "Average SAT Math Score", t.avgscrwrite AS "Average SAT Writing Score", f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS "Charter School Status", f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "K-12 Enrollment (2014-2015)", ROUND(CAST(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "Percent Eligible Free/Reduced Price Meals", b.topmath AS "Highest Average Math Score", b.topmath - t.avgscrmath AS "Gap Below Highest Math Score" FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.cdscode LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 7618040113118

WITH virtual_counts AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS virtual_schools FROM schools WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county), top_counties AS (SELECT county, virtual_schools FROM virtual_counts WHERE virtual_schools >= (SELECT MIN(virtual_schools) FROM (SELECT virtual_schools FROM virtual_counts ORDER BY virtual_schools DESC NULLS LAST, county NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5) AS __photo_derived_1)), best AS (SELECT s.county, s.school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.county ORDER BY sat.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST) AS r FROM schools AS s JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE s.virtual = 'F' AND NOT sat.avgscrread IS NULL) SELECT t.county, t.virtual_schools, COALESCE(b.school, 'None') AS school FROM top_counties AS t LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.county = t.county AND b.r = 1 ORDER BY t.virtual_schools DESC NULLS LAST, t.county NULLS FIRST

WITH target AS (SELECT county FROM schools WHERE CASE WHEN (cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = 1100170109835), cands AS (SELECT county FROM target UNION SELECT 'Santa Barbara') SELECT c.county AS county, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS s WHERE s.county = c.county AND s.virtual = 'F') AS num FROM cands AS c ORDER BY num DESC NULLS LAST, c.county NULLS FIRST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT f.cdscode, f."School Name" AS schoolname, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpmcount, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpmshare, CASE WHEN (f.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((f.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS code_num FROM frpm AS f WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100) SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS requestpart, c.schoolname AS schoolname, s.county AS county, s.city AS city, s.mailstreet AS mailingstreet, s.mailcity AS mailingcity, s.mailstate AS mailingstate, s.mailzip AS mailingzip, s.website AS website, c.enrollment AS enrollment, c.frpmcount AS frpmcount, c.frpmshare AS frpmshare, t.avgscrread + t.avgscrmath + t.avgscrwrite AS avgtotalsat, CAST(t.numge1500 * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t.numtsttakr, 0), 0) AS pct1500plus, s.opendate AS opendate, CASE WHEN NOT s.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS schoolstatus FROM cohort AS c JOIN schools AS s ON c.code_num = CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON c.code_num = CASE WHEN (t.cds) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t.cds) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END WHERE c.frpmcount = (SELECT MAX(x.frpmcount) FROM cohort AS x) UNION ALL SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', c.schoolname, s.county, s.city, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip, s.website, c.enrollment, c.frpmcount, c.frpmshare, t.avgscrread + t.avgscrmath + t.avgscrwrite, CAST(t.numge1500 * 100.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t.numtsttakr, 0), 0), s.opendate, CASE WHEN NOT s.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END FROM cohort AS c JOIN schools AS s ON c.code_num = CASE WHEN (s.cdscode) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((s.cdscode) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON c.code_num = CASE WHEN (t.cds) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t.cds) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END WHERE c.frpmshare = (SELECT MIN(x.frpmshare) FROM cohort SELECT DISTINCT name FROM cards WHERE ispromo = 1 AND NOT side IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) FROM cards)
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM cards WHERE ispromo = 1 AND NOT side IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(CAST(originalreleasedate AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019'

SELECT s.name AS set_name, s.releasedate AS release_date FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setcode WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf' AND c.frameversion ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CASE WHEN (c.frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((c.frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = CASE WHEN (c.frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((c.frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AND CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.releasedate AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.releasedate AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (c.frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((c.frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END >= 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell' AND f.language IN ('French', 'Italian') AND c.id IN (SELECT c2.id FROM cards AS c2 JOIN foreign_data AS f2 ON c2.uuid = f2.uuid WHERE c2.name = 'Counterspell' AND f2.language = 'French' INTERSECT SELECT c3.id FROM cards AS c3 JOIN foreign_data AS f3 ON c3.uuid = f3.uuid WHERE c3.name = 'Counterspell' AND f3.language = 'Italian')

SELECT s.name, s.releasedate FROM sets AS s WHERE s.type = (SELECT type FROM sets WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM set_translations AS t WHERE t.setcode = s.code AND NOT t.translation IS NULL) ORDER BY s.releasedate NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS setname, s.releasedate FROM cards AS c JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setcode WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor' AND CASE WHEN (c.frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((c.frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) FROM cards WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor') AND s.releasedate = (SELECT MAX(s2.releasedate) FROM cards AS c2 JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setcode WHERE c2.name = 'Aven Mindcensor' AND CASE WHEN (c2.frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((c2.frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (frameversion) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((frameversion) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) FROM cards WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'))

SELECT s.code, s.releasedate FROM sets AS s WHERE s.releasedate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM set_translations AS t WHERE t.setcode = s.code AND t.language = 'Spanish' AND NOT t.translation IS NULL) ORDER BY s.releasedate NULLS FIRST, s.code NULLS FIRST
SELECT SUM(convertedmanacost) AS total_converted_mana_cost FROM cards WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(originalreleasedate AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(n) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_languages FROM (SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT st.translation IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(st.translation AS TEXT)) <> '' THEN st.language END) AS n FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON s.code = st.setcode WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(s.releasedate AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2016' GROUP BY s.id) AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT s.block AS block, COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS translated_sets, SUM(s.basesetsize) AS total_base_set_size FROM sets AS s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT setcode FROM set_translations) AS st ON s.code = st.setcode WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage') GROUP BY s.block ORDER BY s.block NULLS FIRST

SELECT f.name AS japanese_card_name, c.type AS card_type, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rulings AS r WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid)) AS ruling_count FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'boros' AND f.language = 'Japanese' GROUP BY f.name, c.type ORDER BY f.name COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST, c.type COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST

WITH set_langs AS (SELECT DISTINCT language FROM set_translations), counts AS (SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printings FROM foreign_data AS fd WHERE fd.language IN (SELECT language FROM set_langs) AND NOT fd.flavortext IS NULL AND fd.flavortext <> '' GROUP BY fd.language) SELECT language, printings FROM counts WHERE printings = (SELECT MIN(printings) FROM counts) ORDER BY language ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS total_creature_cards FROM cards WHERE CASE WHEN (power) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((power) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 10 AND CAST(types AS TEXT) LIKE '%Creature%' AND setcode IN (SELECT setcode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'French' AND NOT translation IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.cmc) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_mana_value FROM (SELECT c.name, c.convertedmanacost AS cmc FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE POSITION('Creature' IN c.types) > 0 AND c.edhrecrank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND l.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY c.name, c.convertedmanacost) AS t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE CASE WHEN (power) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((power) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 3 AND CASE WHEN (power) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((power) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END <= 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS printings FROM cards AS c JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setcode WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(c.originalreleasedate AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2014' AND NOT s.mtgocode IS NULL

WITH counts AS (SELECT f.language, COUNT(*) AS printings FROM foreign_data AS f WHERE f.language IN (SELECT DISTINCT language FROM set_translations) GROUP BY f.language) SELECT language, printings FROM counts WHERE printings = (SELECT MIN(printings) FROM counts)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printings_with_italian_rules_text FROM foreign_data AS f JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = f.uuid JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setcode WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND f.language = 'Italian' AND TRIM(CAST(f.text AS TEXT)) <> ''

WITH cohort AS (SELECT * FROM sets WHERE type = 'commander' AND releasedate >= '2020-01-01' AND releasedate <= '2020-12-31') SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS languages FROM cohort AS c LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setcode = c.code WHERE c.totalsetsize = (SELECT MAX(totalsetsize) FROM cohort) GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS language_count FROM foreign_data AS fd JOIN cards AS c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count FROM cards AS c WHERE c.colors = 'B' AND CAST(c.type AS TEXT) LIKE '%Artifact%' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data AS f WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid AND LENGTH(CAST(f.flavortext AS TEXT)) > 0)
SELECT t2.displayname FROM posts AS t1 INNER JOIN users AS t2 ON t1.lasteditoruserid = t2.id WHERE t1.title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

WITH once_per_post AS (SELECT h.postid, h.userid FROM posthistory AS h JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = h.postid WHERE p.viewcount >= 1000 AND NOT h.userid IS NULL GROUP BY h.postid, h.userid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) SELECT DISTINCT userid FROM once_per_post ORDER BY userid NULLS FIRST

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) - CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) FROM badges WHERE name = 'Student'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(p.tags AS TEXT) LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT p.id, u.displayname FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(p.creaiondate AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2010' AND NOT p.favoritecount IS NULL ORDER BY p.favoritecount DESC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT p.viewcount, u.displayname FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.id = p.lasteditoruserid WHERE LOWER(p.title) = LOWER('Computer game datasets')

SELECT c.text, u.displayname FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c.postid = p.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE p.title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY c.creationdate DESC NULLS LAST, c.id DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM posts WHERE owneruserid IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM users))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = c.postid WHERE c.score = 0 AND c.postid IN (SELECT x.postid FROM comments AS x GROUP BY x.postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS combined_reputation FROM users AS u WHERE CAST(u.location AS TEXT) LIKE '%United Kingdom%' AND u.id IN (SELECT p.owneruserid FROM posts AS p WHERE NOT p.owneruserid IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.age) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_age FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t2.id, t2.age FROM comments AS t1 INNER JOIN users AS t2 ON t1.userid = t2.id WHERE CAST(t1.text AS TEXT) LIKE '%http://%') AS t

WITH organizer AS (SELECT userid, MIN(date) AS organizer_date FROM badges WHERE name = 'Organizer' GROUP BY userid) SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM organizer AS o JOIN users AS u ON u.id = o.userid WHERE CAST(u.location AS TEXT) LIKE '%Germany%' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges AS b WHERE b.userid = o.userid AND b.date < o.organizer_date) >= 5

WITH RECURSIVE fp AS (SELECT owneruserid AS uid, MIN(creaiondate) AS fdate FROM posts WHERE NOT owneruserid IS NULL GROUP BY owneruserid), locs AS (SELECT u.id AS uid, u.location AS loc FROM users AS u JOIN fp ON fp.uid = u.id WHERE fp.fdate >= '2010-01-01' AND fp.fdate < '2011-01-01'), parts(uid, head, tail) AS (SELECT uid, CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN loc) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(loc AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN loc) - 1) ELSE loc END, CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN loc) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(loc AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN loc) + 1) ELSE NULL END FROM locs UNION ALL SELECT uid, CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN tail) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(tail AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN tail) - 1) ELSE tail END, CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN tail) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(tail AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN tail) + 1) ELSE NULL END FROM parts WHERE NOT tail IS NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_in_india FROM parts WHERE TRIM(CAST(head AS TEXT)) = 'India'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)) AS avg_reputation FROM users AS u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT p.owneruserid FROM posts AS p WHERE p.score < 20 AND CAST(p.tags AS TEXT) LIKE '%' || '<' || 'r' || '>' || '%')

WITH posts_2012 AS (SELECT id, score, lasteditoruserid AS editorid FROM posts WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01'), german_editors AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.reputation FROM posts_2012 AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.id = p.editorid WHERE CAST(u.location AS TEXT) LIKE '%Germany%') SELECT (SELECT SUM(p.score) FROM posts_2012 AS p JOIN german_editors AS g ON g.id = p.editorid) AS german_edited_score, (SELECT SUM(score) FROM posts_2012 WHERE editorid IS NULL OR NOT editorid IN (SELECT id FROM german_editors)) AS remaining_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM german_editors) AS editor_count, (SELECT SUM(reputation) FROM german_editors) AS editor_reputation
SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS combined_reputation FROM users AS u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT p.owneruserid FROM posts AS p WHERE p.score = 10 AND CAST(p.tags AS TEXT) ILIKE '%' || '<' || 'R' || '>' || '%')

SELECT SUM(reputation) AS combined_reputation FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE CAST(tags AS TEXT) ILIKE '%' || '<' || 'R' || '>' || '%' AND CAST(lasactivitydate AS TEXT) LIKE '2014-08-27%')

WITH target AS (SELECT id FROM posts WHERE title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'), linkers AS (SELECT DISTINCT pl.postid AS pid FROM postlinks AS pl INNER JOIN target AS tg ON pl.relatedpostid = tg.id) SELECT SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM linkers AS l INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = l.pid WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tags AS t WHERE t.tagname = 'r' AND CAST(p.tags AS TEXT) LIKE '%' || '<' || t.tagname || '>' || '%')

WITH per_user AS (SELECT u.id, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id WHERE CAST(u.location AS TEXT) LIKE '%Germany%' GROUP BY u.id, u.displayname) SELECT displayname, badge_count FROM per_user WHERE badge_count = (SELECT MAX(badge_count) FROM per_user AS p2 WHERE p2.badge_count < (SELECT MAX(badge_count) FROM per_user)) ORDER BY displayname NULLS FIRST

WITH ca AS (SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM users WHERE POSITION(',' || 'CA' || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(location AS TEXT))), ' ', '') || ',') > 0 OR POSITION(',' || UPPER('California') || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(location AS TEXT))), ' ', '') || ',') > 0) SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM ca WHERE views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM ca)

SELECT age FROM users WHERE POSITION(',' || 'York' || ',' IN ',' || location || ',') > 0 AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM users WHERE POSITION(',' || 'York' || ',' IN ',' || location || ',') > 0)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.userid) AS user_count FROM badges AS t1 INNER JOIN users AS t2 ON t1.userid = t2.id WHERE CAST(t2.location AS TEXT) LIKE '%India%' AND t1.name = 'Yearling' AND t1.date < '2014-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.displayname IS NULL OR u.displayname = 'NaN' THEN NULL ELSE u.displayname END) AS different_display_names FROM users AS u INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.name = 'Supporter' AND u.age BETWEEN 19 AND 65

WITH counts AS (SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS title, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS related_posts FROM posts AS p JOIN postlinks AS pl ON pl.postid = p.id WHERE CAST(p.title AS TEXT) LIKE '%principal component scores%' GROUP BY p.id, p.title) SELECT title, related_posts FROM counts WHERE related_posts = (SELECT MAX(related_posts) FROM counts) ORDER BY title NULLS FIRST
SELECT id FROM users WHERE displayname = 'Michael' AND age = (SELECT MIN(age) FROM users WHERE displayname = 'Michael') ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.owneruserid AS TEXT), p.ownerdisplayname)) AS users FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON v.postid = p.id WHERE v.bountyamount >= 30 AND v.creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND v.creationdate < '2011-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(u.reputation) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_reputation FROM users AS u WHERE (TRIM(CAST(u.location AS TEXT)) = 'India' OR (POSITION(',' IN u.location) > 0 AND TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(u.location AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN u.location) + 1) AS TEXT)) = 'India')) AND u.id IN (SELECT p.owneruserid FROM posts AS p WHERE p.creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND p.creaiondate < '2011-01-01')

WITH active AS (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(u.upvotes) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_upvotes, ROUND(CAST(AVG(u.age) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_age FROM active AS a JOIN users AS u ON u.id = a.owneruserid

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(month_cnt)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(month_cnt)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(12, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(CAST(t1.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM') AS mon, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.postid) AS month_cnt FROM postlinks AS t1 INNER JOIN posts AS t2 ON t1.postid = t2.id WHERE t2.answercount <= 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2010' GROUP BY mon) AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.reputation >= 1000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN t2.reputation >= 1000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM posts AS t1 LEFT JOIN users AS t2 ON t1.owneruserid = t2.id WHERE t1.score > 5 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.creaiondate AS TIMESTAMP)) = '2010'

WITH target AS (SELECT id FROM posts WHERE title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'), counts AS (SELECT u.displayname, COUNT(*) AS n FROM posthistory AS h JOIN users AS u ON u.id = h.userid WHERE h.postid IN (SELECT id FROM target) AND NOT h.comment IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(h.comment AS TEXT)) <> '' GROUP BY u.displayname) SELECT displayname, n FROM counts WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM counts)

WITH annual AS (SELECT c.segment, c.customerid, SUM(CAST(y.consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS total FROM customers AS c JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND NOT y.consumption IS NULL AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY c.segment, c.customerid), ranked AS (SELECT segment, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total NULLS FIRST, customerid NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM annual), chosen AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END) AS sme, MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END) AS lam, MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END) AS kam FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(sme - lam AS DECIMAL), 2), ROUND(CAST(lam - kam AS DECIMAL), 2), ROUND(CAST(kam - sme AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM chosen

WITH annual AS (SELECT c.segment, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(y.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(y.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013 FROM customers AS c JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.customerid = y.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND SUBSTRING(CAST(y.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY c.segment), rates AS (SELECT segment, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (total_2013 - total_2012) / NULLIF(NULLIF(total_2012, 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS increase_pct FROM annual WHERE total_2012 > 0), ranked AS (SELECT segment, increase_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY increase_pct DESC NULLS LAST) AS highest_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY increase_pct ASC NULLS FIRST) AS lowest_rank FROM rates) SELECT segment, increase_pct FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1 OR lowest_rank = 1 ORDER BY increase_pct DESC NULLS LAST, segment NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(ym.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(ym.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(ym.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL(20, 8)) AS DECIMAL), 4) FROM yearmonth AS ym WHERE ym.customerid = (SELECT t.customerid FROM transactions_1k AS t WHERE t.date = '2012-08-25' AND CAST(t.price AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) = 634.80)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customerid FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' AND customerid IN (SELECT customerid FROM customers WHERE currency = 'EUR') INTERSECT SELECT customerid FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013') AS __photo_derived_1

WITH yearly AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE date >= '201201' AND date <= '201212' GROUP BY customerid HAVING SUM(consumption) < 30000) SELECT c.segment AS segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM yearly AS y INNER JOIN customers AS c ON c.customerid = y.customerid GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment NULLS FIRST

SELECT c.segment AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customers_with_fuel_2013 FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.customerid = y.customerid WHERE y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND y.consumption > 0 GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment NULLS FIRST

SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(MAX(date || ' ' || time) AS TIMESTAMP)) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(MIN(date || ' ' || time) AS TIMESTAMP))) / NULLIF((5 * 13 - 5), 0) AS minutes FROM transactions_1k AS t1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS t2 ON t1.gasstationid = t2.gasstationid WHERE t2.country = 'CZE' AND t1.price > 1000

WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT '201301' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (m) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((m) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END + 1 AS TEXT) FROM months WHERE m < '201311'), steady AS (SELECT customerid FROM yearmonth WHERE date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311' AND consumption > 0 GROUP BY customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM months)) SELECT c.currency, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM steady AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.customerid = s.customerid GROUP BY c.currency

WITH q2 AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS total FROM yearmonth WHERE date BETWEEN '201304' AND '201306' GROUP BY customerid) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN q2.total END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS eur_avg_quarter, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN q2.total END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS czk_avg_quarter FROM customers AS c JOIN q2 ON q2.customerid = c.customerid

SELECT ROUND(CAST((SELECT SUM(CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 5 FOR 2) ORDER BY SUM(CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) - (SELECT SUM(CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 5 FOR 2) ORDER BY SUM(CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS difference

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(consumption) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE customerid = 15621 AND date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND consumption > 0

WITH per_customer AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS tot_2012 FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' GROUP BY customerid) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN p.tot_2012 END) - AVG(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN p.tot_2012 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS diff FROM customers AS c JOIN per_customer AS p ON c.customerid = p.customerid

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT t2.customerid FROM customers AS t1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS t2 ON t1.customerid = t2.customerid WHERE t1.currency = 'CZK' AND t1.segment = 'KAM' AND CAST(t2.date AS TEXT) LIKE '2013%' GROUP BY t2.customerid HAVING SUM(t2.consumption) > 1000000) AS __photo_derived_1

WITH oldest AS (SELECT c.client_id FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM district) ORDER BY c.birth_date NULLS FIRST, c.client_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM district) FROM oldest AS o JOIN disp AS x ON x.client_id = o.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = x.account_id ORDER BY a.account_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT d.a2 FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS x ON x.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = x.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29' ORDER BY d.a2 NULLS FIRST

WITH chosen AS (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CASE WHEN (a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST, district_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM client AS c JOIN chosen AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT CASE WHEN ((SUM(CASE WHEN t3.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t3.balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t3.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t3.balance ELSE 0 END))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(((SUM(CASE WHEN t3.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t3.balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t3.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t3.balance ELSE 0 END))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t3.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t3.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM loan AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS t3 ON t3.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.date = '1993-07-05'

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.frequency FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id WHERE t2.a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'

SELECT DISTINCT d.a2, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (CAST(d.a13 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) - CAST(d.a12 AS DECIMAL(10, 2))) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(d.a12 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status = 'D' AND d.a12 <> 0 AND NOT d.a13 IS NULL ORDER BY d.a2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM district AS x JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = x.district_id JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER' AND x.a11 > 8000 AND x.a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY d.type ORDER BY d.type NULLS FIRST

SELECT CASE WHEN ((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1997' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1996' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1997' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1996' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1996' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM loan AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS t3 ON t3.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t4 ON t4.client_id = t3.client_id WHERE t4.gender = 'M' AND t3.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT t1.frequency, t2.k_symbol FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, k_symbol, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id, k_symbol) AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.account_id = 3 AND t2.total_amount = 3539

WITH first_month AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(CAST(MIN(date) AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM') AS ym FROM account), first_month_districts AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM account WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM') = (SELECT ym FROM first_month)), cohort AS (SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants FROM district AS d JOIN first_month_districts AS f ON d.district_id = f.district_id) SELECT district_name, inhabitants FROM cohort WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM cohort)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans AS t WHERE (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(t.k_symbol AS TEXT)) = '') AND t.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp AS d INNER JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976')

WITH populous AS (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CASE WHEN (a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5), per_district AS (SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(a.account_id), 0) AS raw_avg FROM district AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM populous) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2) SELECT district_name, ROUND(CAST(raw_avg AS DECIMAL), 0) AS avg_active_loan_per_account FROM per_district ORDER BY raw_avg DESC NULLS LAST, district_name NULLS FIRST

WITH ends AS (SELECT d.a3 AS region, l.amount, DATE(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END + (CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 2)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 2)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - 1 + l.duration) / NULLIF(12, 0) AS TEXT) || '-' || RIGHT(CAST('0' || ((CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 2)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 2)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - 1 + l.duration) % 12 + 1) AS TEXT), 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 9 FOR 2)) AS end_date FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.date <= '1995-12-31'), totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM ends WHERE end_date >= '1995-12-31' GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM totals WHERE rnk = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS qualifying_accounts FROM district AS d JOIN account AS a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND a.date <= '1995-12-31' AND t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(x.a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) AS district_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t1.district_id, t1.a11 FROM district AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t4 ON t3.client_id = t4.client_id WHERE t1.a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t4.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989') AS x

WITH qualified AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id FROM disp AS d JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district AS dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND dist.a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card AS ca JOIN disp AS cd ON ca.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE cd.account_id = d.account_id)) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_salary FROM district WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM qualified)

WITH owner AS (SELECT t2.account_id, t1.birth_date FROM client AS t1 INNER JOIN disp AS t2 ON t1.client_id = t2.client_id WHERE t2.type = 'OWNER') SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (COUNT(t3.loan_id)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(t3.loan_id)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t4.account_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_loans_per_account FROM owner AS t4 LEFT JOIN loan AS t3 ON t4.account_id = t3.account_id WHERE t4.birth_date < '1950-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS household_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT t.k_symbol IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(t.k_symbol AS TEXT)) <> '' AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS other_purpose_payments FROM trans AS t JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND t.amount > 4000

WITH borrowers AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opening_date, (SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM loan AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_borrowed FROM account AS a WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice') AND a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan)), owners AS (SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id FROM disp AS d JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'), counterparties AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS cnt FROM trans WHERE account > 0 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT bo.account_id, bo.opening_date, bo.total_borrowed, COALESCE(cp.cnt, 0) AS counterparty_count, hd.a2 AS home_district, CASE WHEN (hd.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((hd.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS home_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN (hd.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((hd.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST) AS population_rank FROM borrowers AS bo LEFT JOIN counterparties AS cp ON cp.account_id = bo.account_id LEFT JOIN owners AS o ON o.account_id = bo.account_id LEFT JOIN district AS hd ON hd.district_id = o.home_district_id ORDER BY population_rank ASC NULLS FIRST, bo.account_id ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH gold_holder AS (SELECT d.account_id, cl.gender FROM card AS c JOIN disp AS d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client AS cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'), acct_bal AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), holder_district AS (SELECT DISTINCT gh.gender, a.district_id FROM gold_holder AS gh JOIN account AS a ON gh.account_id = a.account_id JOIN acct_bal AS ab ON ab.account_id = a.account_id AND ab.avg_balance > 1000), big AS (SELECT hd.gender, di.a2 AS name, CASE WHEN (di.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((di.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants, di.a11 AS salary, di.a10 AS urban FROM holder_district AS hd JOIN district AS di ON hd.district_id = di.district_id WHERE CASE WHEN (di.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((di.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END > 100000), ranked AS (SELECT gender, name, inhabitants, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS district_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_district_salary, ROUND(CAST(AVG(urban) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY inhabitants DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM big) SELECT gender, district_count, name AS largest_district_name, inhabitants AS largest_district_inhabitants, avg_district_salary, avg_urban_ratio FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS FIRST, name NULLS FIRST

WITH gold_accounts AS (SELECT d.account_id FROM card AS c JOIN disp AS d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'), outgoing AS (SELECT t.bank AS bank, t.account AS account, COUNT(*) AS n_payments, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts) AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31' AND t.account > 0 AND CASE WHEN (di.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((di.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END >= 250000 GROUP BY t.bank, t.account) SELECT bank, account, n_payments, total_amount FROM outgoing WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM outgoing) ORDER BY bank NULLS FIRST, account NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS sipo_percentage_of_purposed_outgoing_payments FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND NOT t.k_symbol IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(t.k_symbol AS TEXT)) <> ''

WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM card) AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan)) SELECT di.a3 AS region, ROUND(CAST(AVG(di.a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_district_salary, ROUND(CAST(AVG(di.a13) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_unemployment_rate_1996, (SELECT di2.a2 FROM district AS di2 WHERE di2.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM cohort) AND di2.a3 = di.a3 ORDER BY CASE WHEN (di2.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((di2.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST, di2.a2 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS most_populous_district FROM district AS di WHERE di.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM cohort) GROUP BY di.a3 ORDER BY di.a3 NULLS FIRST

WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants, d.a16 AS crimes_1996 FROM district AS d WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST, d.a2 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3) SELECT r.district_name, r.crimes_1996, ROUND(CAST((SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM ranked) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_crimes_top3_1996, ROUND(CAST((SELECT AVG(a16) FROM district) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_crimes_all_districts_1996, ROUND(CAST((SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM ranked) - (SELECT AVG(a16) FROM district) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference FROM ranked AS r ORDER BY r.inhabitants DESC NULLS LAST, r.district_name NULLS FIRST

WITH holder_districts AS (SELECT DISTINCT cd.type AS card_type, cl.district_id FROM card AS cd JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id), ranked AS (SELECT hd.card_type, ds.a2 AS district_name, CASE WHEN (ds.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((ds.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.card_type ORDER BY CASE WHEN (ds.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((ds.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END NULLS FIRST) AS rnk FROM holder_districts AS hd JOIN district AS ds ON ds.district_id = hd.district_id) SELECT card_type, district_name, inhabitants FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY card_type NULLS FIRST

WITH region AS (SELECT a3 AS r FROM district WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), op AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.a3 = (SELECT r FROM region) AND a.date >= '1996-01-01' AND a.date < '1997-01-01'), lastd AS (SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.date) AS md FROM trans AS t WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31' AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM op) GROUP BY t.account_id), lastt AS (SELECT l.account_id, MAX(t.trans_id) AS mt FROM lastd AS l JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date = l.md GROUP BY l.account_id), eb AS (SELECT x.account_id, tr.balance AS bal FROM lastt AS x JOIN trans AS tr ON tr.trans_id = x.mt), rd AS (SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_in_1996, AVG(e.bal) AS raw_avg FROM op AS o JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = o.district_id JOIN eb AS e ON e.account_id = o.account_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2) SELECT rd.district_name, rd.accounts_opened_in_1996, ROUND(CAST(rd.raw_avg AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_end_of_1996_balance, (SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(bal) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM eb) AS region_average_end_of_1996_balance, (SELECT district_name FROM rd ORDER BY raw_avg DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS district_with_highest_average_end_of_1996_balance FROM rd ORDER BY rd.district_name NULLS FIRST

WITH ranked AS (SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC NULLS LAST, l.loan_id ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), top10 AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10), districts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants, d.a11 AS avg_salary FROM district AS d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM top10) AS t ON t.district_id = d.district_id) SELECT (SELECT district_name FROM districts ORDER BY inhabitants DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS most_populous_district, (SELECT inhabitants FROM districts ORDER BY inhabitants DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS inhabitants, (SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_salary) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM districts) AS avg_district_salary

WITH wd AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY a.district_id), acct AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accounts FROM account GROUP BY district_id), so AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS so_total FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id) SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS population, wd.total AS total_withdrawn, ROUND(CAST(wd.total / NULLIF(CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wd.total / NULLIF(CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS per_inhabitant_rank, ROUND(CAST(so.so_total * 1.0 / NULLIF(acct.n_accounts, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account FROM district AS d JOIN wd ON wd.district_id = d.district_id JOIN acct ON acct.district_id = d.district_id JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id WHERE CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END >= 100000 ORDER BY per_inhabitant_rank NULLS FIRST, district_name NULLS FIRST

WITH acct AS (SELECT d.account_id, a.date AS opened, a.frequency AS freq, a.district_id AS branch_district, c.district_id AS home_district FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE c.client_id = 3541), stats AS (SELECT ac.account_id, ac.opened, ac.freq, ac.branch_district, ac.home_district, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense FROM acct AS ac LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = ac.account_id GROUP BY ac.account_id, ac.opened, ac.freq, ac.branch_district, ac.home_district), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, a3 AS region, a2 AS district_name, CASE WHEN (a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS inhabitants, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CASE WHEN (a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST) AS pop_rank FROM district) SELECT s.account_id, s.opened AS opening_date, s.freq AS frequency, bd.a2 AS district_where_held, bd.a3 AS region, CASE WHEN bd.district_id = s.home_district THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_client_home_district, bd.a11 AS district_avg_salary, COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status, COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount, s.transaction_count, s.total_income, s.total_expense, s.total_income - s.total_expense AS net_balance, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.client_id) FROM client AS c2 JOIN district AS d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id WHERE d2.a3 = bd.a3) AS clients_home_district_in_region, mp.district_name AS most_populous_district, mp.inhabitants AS most_populous_inhabitants, rk.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region FROM stats AS s JOIN district AS bd ON bd.district_id = s.branch_district JOIN ranked AS rk ON rk.district_id = bd.district_id JOIN ranked AS mp ON mp.region = bd.a3 AND mp.pop_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = s.account_id ORDER BY s.transaction_count DESC NULLS LAST, s.account_id ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH cba AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS y FROM account AS a INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'), branch AS (SELECT cba.y, cba.district_id, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cba.account_id), 0) AS lent_per_account FROM cba LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = cba.account_id GROUP BY cba.y, cba.district_id) SELECT yt.y AS opening_year, yt.accounts_opened, yl.total_lent, ROUND(CAST(b.avg_lent AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_amount_lent_per_account FROM (SELECT y, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts_opened FROM cba GROUP BY y) AS yt INNER JOIN (SELECT y, SUM(l.amount) AS total_lent FROM cba LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = cba.account_id GROUP BY y) AS yl ON yl.y = yt.y INNER JOIN (SELECT y, AVG(lent_per_account) AS avg_lent FROM branch GROUP BY y) AS b ON b.y = yt.y ORDER BY yt.y NULLS FIRST

WITH top_loans AS (SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date AS loan_date, d.a2 AS district_name FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY l.amount DESC NULLS LAST, l.date ASC NULLS FIRST, l.loan_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10) SELECT district_name, amount AS approved_amount, loan_date AS approval_date, (SELECT t.balance FROM trans AS t WHERE t.account_id = top_loans.account_id AND t.date <= top_loans.loan_date ORDER BY t.date DESC NULLS LAST, t.trans_id DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS balance_at_approval FROM top_loans ORDER BY approved_amount DESC NULLS LAST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, cd.type AS card_type, (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(cd.issued AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(cd.issued AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) AS age_at_issue, d.account_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a11 AS district_avg_salary FROM card AS cd JOIN disp AS d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district AS di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(cd.issued AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1994') SELECT co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_borrowed, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 AND co.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_category, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY co.gender ORDER BY co.age_at_issue NULLS FIRST) AS age_rank_within_gender FROM cohort AS co LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON co.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary ORDER BY co.client_id NULLS FIRST

WITH branch_counts AS (SELECT d.a2 AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS unstated_transactions FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a3 = 'north Moravia' AND t.date <= '1998-10-14' AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(t.k_symbol AS TEXT)) = '') GROUP BY d.a2) SELECT branch_name, unstated_transactions FROM branch_counts ORDER BY unstated_transactions DESC NULLS LAST, branch_name ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

SELECT t.bank AS bank_code, t.account AS counterparty_account, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid FROM trans AS t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan AS l WHERE l.date = '1996-01-03' AND l.amount = 98832) AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date < '1996-01-03' AND t.account > 0 GROUP BY t.bank, t.account ORDER BY total_paid DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND a.date <= '1995-12-31' AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net_interest FROM trans AS t WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' AND CAST(t.k_symbol AS TEXT) LIKE '%UROK%' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM disp AS d WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id AND d.client_id = 2823)

WITH female_loans AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.district_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN loan AS l ON d.account_id = l.account_id JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F'), region_loans AS (SELECT da.a3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS da ON a.district_id = da.district_id GROUP BY da.a3), region_salary AS (SELECT a3 AS region, ROUND(CAST(AVG(a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_district_salary FROM district GROUP BY a3), acct_trans AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT fl.client_id, fl.amount AS loan_amount, fl.duration AS loan_duration_months, ROUND(CAST(fl.payments * fl.duration AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_payments, ROUND(CAST(fl.payments * fl.duration - fl.amount AS DECIMAL), 2) AS interest_paid, fl.status AS loan_status, di.a2 AS branch_district, di.a3 AS region, at.transaction_count, at.total_credits AS total_deposits, CASE WHEN at.total_credits > fl.amount * 2 THEN 'High Income' WHEN at.total_credits > fl.amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category, rl.loans_in_region, rs.avg_district_salary AS region_avg_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST('2026-10-09' AS TIMESTAMP)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(fl.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP)) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM-DD') < TO_CHAR(CAST(fl.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS client_age FROM female_loans AS fl JOIN district AS di ON fl.district_id = di.district_id JOIN region_loans AS rl ON di.a3 = rl.region JOIN region_salary AS rs ON di.a3 = rs.region LEFT JOIN acct_trans AS at ON fl.account_id = at.account_id WHERE fl.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY fl.amount DESC NULLS LAST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT l.account_id, a.district_id FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 24 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.date AS TIMESTAMP)) < '1997'), region_districts AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region, CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS population FROM district AS d JOIN cohort AS c ON d.district_id = c.district_id) SELECT r.region, COUNT(*) AS num_districts, SUM(r.population) AS total_population, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort AS c JOIN region_districts AS x ON c.district_id = x.district_id WHERE x.region = r.region) AS num_accounts FROM region_districts AS r GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY total_population DESC NULLS LAST, r.region ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH qualifying_districts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.a11 FROM district AS d WHERE CASE WHEN (d.a4) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((d.a4) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END >= 100000 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account AS a WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND a.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31')) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account AS a JOIN qualifying_districts AS q ON a.district_id = q.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND a.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') AS monthly_accounts_opened_1997, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_districts) AS district_count, (SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM qualifying_districts) AS avg_district_salary

WITH gold_accounts AS (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp AS d JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.type = 'gold' GROUP BY d.account_id), trans_stats AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT bank IS NULL THEN account END) AS external_counterparty_accounts FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), loan_stats AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count FROM loan GROUP BY account_id) SELECT g.account_id, di.a2 AS district, di.a3 AS region, COALESCE(t.total_received, 0) AS total_received, COALESCE(t.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn, COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(t.external_counterparty_accounts, 0) AS external_counterparty_accounts, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.external_counterparty_accounts, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS counterparty_rank FROM gold_accounts AS g JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = g.account_id JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans_stats AS t ON t.account_id = g.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_stats AS l ON l.account_id = g.account_id ORDER BY counterparty_rank NULLS FIRST, g.account_id NULLS FIRST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor' AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'), own AS (SELECT co.account_id, co.open_date, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM cohort AS co JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = co.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id), cards96 AS (SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(cd.card_id) AS n_cards FROM disp AS dp JOIN card AS cd ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE cd.issued <= '1996-12-31' GROUP BY dp.account_id), loans96 AS (SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_bad, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_run FROM loan AS l WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.account_id), t1997 AS (SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_trans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type <> 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out, MAX(t.balance) AS max_bal FROM trans AS t WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY t.account_id) SELECT o.account_id, o.open_date AS date_opened, o.gender AS owner_gender, 1996 -
