CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(o.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(o.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS owner_age_at_end_1996, COALESCE(c.n_cards, 0) AS cards_by_end_1996, COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) AS loans_by_end_1996, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN l.n_bad > 0 THEN 'defaulted' WHEN l.n_run > 0 THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_standing, COALESCE(t.n_trans, 0) AS trans_1997_count, COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997, COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997, COALESCE(t.max_bal, 0) AS max_balance_1997, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.max_bal, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS balance_rank FROM own AS o LEFT JOIN cards96 AS c ON c.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN loans96 AS l ON l.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN t1997 AS t ON t.account_id = o.account_id ORDER BY balance_rank NULLS FIRST, o.account_id NULLS FIRST

WITH holders AS (SELECT dp.client_id, dp.account_id, a.district_id FROM card AS c JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE c.type = 'classic') SELECT d.a2 AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT h.client_id) AS classic_card_holders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS external_accounts_paid, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_amount_paid FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN holders AS h ON h.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = h.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.account > 0 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC NULLS LAST, district ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(d.a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_salary FROM district AS d WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT a.district_id FROM account AS a JOIN disp AS x ON x.account_id = a.account_id JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = x.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t1.a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_salary FROM district AS t1 WHERE t1.district_id IN (SELECT t2.district_id FROM client AS t2 WHERE t2.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t2.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP)) < '1950')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(d.a11) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_district_salary FROM district AS d WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT a.district_id FROM account AS a WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan AS l WHERE l.amount < 100000 AND l.status = 'C'))

WITH cohort_districts AS (SELECT a.district_id, CASE WHEN c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS cohort FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' OR c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31' GROUP BY a.district_id, CASE WHEN c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END) SELECT cohort, CASE WHEN (ROUND(AVG(x.a11))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((ROUND(AVG(x.a11))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS avg_salary FROM cohort_districts AS cd JOIN district AS x ON x.district_id = cd.district_id GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 853 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) END) - MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 854 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) END)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 854 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) END), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceid IN (853, 854)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN x.positionorder <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM results AS x JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year >= 2010

WITH wins AS (SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM results WHERE positionorder = 1 GROUP BY driverid), winner AS (SELECT driverid FROM wins ORDER BY win_count DESC NULLS LAST, driverid NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(s.points) FROM driverstandings AS s WHERE s.driverid = d.driverid) FROM winner AS w JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = w.driverid

WITH finished AS (SELECT x.positionorder, x.milliseconds FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN status AS s ON s.statusid = x.statusid WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1988 AND s.status = 'Finished' AND NOT x.milliseconds IS NULL), extremes AS (SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN positionorder = 1 THEN milliseconds END) AS winner_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN positionorder = (SELECT MAX(positionorder) FROM finished) THEN milliseconds END) AS last_ms FROM finished) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (last_ms - winner_ms) / NULLIF(NULLIF(last_ms, 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM extremes

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN x.laps = (SELECT y.laps FROM results AS y WHERE y.raceid = x.raceid AND y.positionorder = 1 ORDER BY y.resultid NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT r.year, FLOOR((SUM(x.milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / NULLIF((10 * COUNT(*)), 0)) / NULLIF(100.0, 0) FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid WHERE r.year < 1975 AND x.positionorder = 1 AND NOT x.milliseconds IS NULL GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year NULLS FIRST

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t3.dob AS TIMESTAMP)) < '1985' AND t1.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t3.dob AS TIMESTAMP)) < '1985' AND t1.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t1.driverid = t3.driverid WHERE t2.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT SUM(t1.points), t2.name, t2.nationality FROM constructorresults AS t1 INNER JOIN constructors AS t2 ON t1.constructorid = t2.constructorid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t3.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE t3.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND t3.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY t2.name, t2.nationality ORDER BY SUM(t1.points) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT t2.forename, t2.surname FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t1.raceid = t3.raceid WHERE NOT q3 IS NULL AND t3.year = 2008 AND t3.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit') ORDER BY CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q3) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q3) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END * 60 + CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q3) + 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN q3) - POSITION(':' IN q3) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q3) + 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN q3) - POSITION(':' IN q3) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END + CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION('.' IN q3) + 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q3 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION('.' IN q3) + 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(1000, 0) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY driverid) SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM per_driver AS p JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = p.driverid ORDER BY p.fastest_ms NULLS FIRST, d.driverid NULLS FIRST LIMIT 20

WITH ranked_laps AS (SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, l.time AS lap_record, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.circuitid ORDER BY l.milliseconds NULLS FIRST, l.raceid NULLS FIRST, l.driverid NULLS FIRST, l.lap NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM laptimes AS l JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = l.raceid JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE c.country = 'Italy' AND l.milliseconds > 0) SELECT circuit_name, lap_record FROM ranked_laps WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY circuit_name NULLS FIRST, circuitid NULLS FIRST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND NOT name IN (SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2000)) SELECT ROUND(CAST(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM cohort)) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob, COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_times FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverid = d.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.dob AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985' GROUP BY d.driverid ORDER BY q3_times DESC NULLS LAST, d.dob ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH t AS (SELECT d.driverref AS driverref, d.nationality AS nationality, d.dob AS dob, q.q1 AS q1 FROM qualifying AS q INNER JOIN races AS r ON q.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1995 AND NOT q.q1 IS NULL AND q.q1 <> '') SELECT a.driverref, a.nationality, a.dob, a.q1 FROM t AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t AS b WHERE CASE WHEN (b.q1) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((b.q1) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > CASE WHEN (a.q1) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a.q1) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END OR (CASE WHEN (b.q1) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((b.q1) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = CASE WHEN (a.q1) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((a.q1) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AND b.q1 > a.q1))

WITH t AS (SELECT d.nationality, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN (REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1)), ':', '')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1)), ':', '')) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year = 1995 AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q1 IS NULL AND q.q1 <> '') SELECT nationality FROM t WHERE rnk = 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1 FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year = 1995 AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q1 IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END ASC NULLS FIRST, CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.driverid) AS drivers_qualified_ahead_of FROM qualifying AS t1 JOIN qualifying AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid AND t2.position > t1.position JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = t1.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas' AND d.surname = 'di Grassi' AND r.year = 2010

SELECT t2.nationality FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t3.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t3.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND t3.year = 2017 AND NOT t1.q2 IS NULL AND t1.q2 <> '' AND t1.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceid = t1.raceid AND NOT q2 IS NULL AND q2 <> '')

SELECT d.forename AS forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS runner_ups FROM races AS r INNER JOIN results AS x ON x.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND x.position = 2 GROUP BY d.forename HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) > 1 ORDER BY runner_ups DESC NULLS LAST, d.forename NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, TO_CHAR(CAST(r.time AS TIME) + CAST('0' || res.time AS INTERVAL), 'HH24:MI:SS') || '.' || RIGHT(CAST(res.time AS TEXT), 3) AS finish_time, d.url FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND res.positionorder = 1

SELECT t2.driverref, t2.nationality, t2.dob FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid INNER JOIN races AS r ON t1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT t1.q2 IS NULL AND t1.q2 <> '' AND (t1.q3 IS NULL OR t1.q3 = '')

WITH q2times AS (SELECT d.nationality, q.q2 FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017 AND NOT q.q2 IS NULL AND q.q2 <> '') SELECT DISTINCT t.nationality FROM q2times AS t WHERE t.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM q2times WHERE q2 > (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM q2times))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS driver_count FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q2 IS NULL AND q.q2 <> '' AND q.q2 < '1:40.000'

SELECT c.name AS racetrack, c.location, c.country, r.year AS season_year, ps.duration AS pit_stop_length FROM pitstops AS ps JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE ps.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitstops) ORDER BY c.name NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(q.q3 > '' OR NULL) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_q3_times_per_driver FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverid = d.driverid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.dob AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1981' AND '1991'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE d.code IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM drivers AS o WHERE o.forename = d.forename AND o.driverid <> d.driverid) AND NOT q.q1 IS NULL AND (CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 2 OR (CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q1) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = 2 AND CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q1 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q1) + 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 0))

SELECT d.driverref AS reference_name, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN results AS r ON r.driverid = d.driverid AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laptimes AS l WHERE l.raceid = r.raceid AND l.driverid = d.driverid) WHERE d.forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.driverref ORDER BY total_points DESC NULLS LAST, reference_name NULLS FIRST

WITH editions AS (SELECT raceid, date FROM races WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND year >= 1990), best AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS best FROM laptimes GROUP BY raceid, driverid) SELECT e.date, d.forename, d.surname, lt.time FROM editions AS e LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.raceid = e.raceid AND b.best > 90 * 1000 LEFT JOIN laptimes AS lt ON lt.raceid = b.raceid AND lt.driverid = b.driverid AND lt.milliseconds = b.best LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = b.driverid ORDER BY e.date NULLS FIRST, d.surname NULLS FIRST, d.forename NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3 AS q3_time FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian' AND q.q3 <> '' AND q.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q2.q3) FROM qualifying AS q2 JOIN drivers AS d2 ON d2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE d2.nationality = 'Italian' AND q2.q3 > '')

WITH cohort AS (SELECT q.driverid, q.raceid, q.q3 FROM drivers AS d JOIN qualifying AS q ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'British' AND CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.dob AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.dob AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END > 1980 AND NOT q.q3 IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(q.q3 AS TEXT)) <> '') SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, r.name AS race_name, r.year AS race_year, c.q3 AS q3_time FROM cohort AS c JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = c.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = c.raceid WHERE c.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM cohort)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.driverid) AS driver_count FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t2.dob AS TIMESTAMP)) >= '1976' AND t1.rank = 2

SELECT d.driverref FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q3 IS NULL AND q.q3 <> '' AND q.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM qualifying WHERE raceid = q.raceid AND NOT q3 IS NULL AND q3 <> '')

WITH season AS (SELECT cs.constructorid, cs.points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY cs.raceid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM constructorstandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = cs.raceid), career AS (SELECT constructorid, SUM(points) AS pts FROM season WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY constructorid), ranked AS (SELECT c.name, COALESCE(cr.pts, 0) AS pts, c.url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.pts, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN career AS cr ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian') SELECT name, pts, url FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY rnk NULLS FIRST, pts DESC NULLS LAST, name NULLS FIRST

SELECT t1.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.driverid) AS winner_drivers FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.positionorder = 1 AND t1.forename IN ('John', 'Peter') GROUP BY t1.forename ORDER BY t1.forename NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE TRIM(CAST(q.q3 AS TEXT)) = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM qualifying WHERE NOT q3 IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(q3 AS TEXT)) <> '')

SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorid END) AS num_constructors FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN results AS r ON c.constructorid = r.constructorid GROUP BY c.nationality ORDER BY num_constructors DESC NULLS LAST, c.nationality NULLS FIRST

WITH oz_races AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.raceid, r.year FROM races AS r INNER JOIN driverstandings AS ds ON ds.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'Australian' AND ds.position <= 19 AND r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013) SELECT oz.year AS season, COUNT(ps.stop) AS pit_stops FROM oz_races AS oz LEFT JOIN pitstops AS ps ON ps.raceid = oz.raceid GROUP BY oz.year ORDER BY oz.year NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.driverid) FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE t2.year = 1995 AND (LENGTH(CAST(t1.q1 AS TEXT)) > LENGTH(CAST('2:00.000' AS TEXT)) OR t1.q1 > '2:00.000')

WITH scope AS (SELECT ps.driverid, ps.duration, ps.milliseconds, r.raceid FROM pitstops AS ps JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01' AND r.date < '2016-10-01') SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, s.duration AS pit_stop_time, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location AS circuit_location FROM scope AS s JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = s.raceid JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE s.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM scope)

WITH winner AS (SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality FROM drivers AS d WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM results AS res WHERE res.driverid = d.driverid AND res.position = 1) ORDER BY d.dob ASC NULLS FIRST, d.forename ASC NULLS FIRST, d.surname ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) SELECT w.forename || ' ' || w.surname AS full_name, w.nationality, (SELECT r.name FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = res.raceid WHERE res.driverid = w.driverid AND res.position = 1 ORDER BY r.date ASC NULLS FIRST, r.name ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS first_win_race, (SELECT r.date FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = res.raceid WHERE res.driverid = w.driverid AND res.position = 1 ORDER BY r.date ASC NULLS FIRST, r.name ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS first_win_date, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) FROM results AS res WHERE res.driverid = w.driverid) AS races_started FROM winner AS w

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.raceid) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid INNER JOIN status AS t3 ON t1.statusid = t3.statusid WHERE t3.status = 'Accident' AND t2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'

WITH t AS (SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, co.name AS constructor, q.q2, q.position, CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q2 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q2) - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q2 AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN q.q2) - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS mins, CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q2 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q2) + 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(q.q2 AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(':' IN q.q2) + 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS secs FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN constructors AS co ON co.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q2 IS NULL AND q.q2 <> '') SELECT forename, surname, constructor FROM t ORDER BY mins ASC NULLS FIRST, secs ASC NULLS FIRST, position ASC NULLS FIRST, driverid ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH t AS (SELECT d.surname AS surname, r.name AS race_name, q.driverid AS driverid, q.q2 AS q2 FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND CAST(q.q2 AS TEXT) LIKE '%:%.%'), m AS (SELECT MIN(q2) AS q2 FROM t) SELECT t.surname, t.race_name FROM t JOIN m ON m.q2 = t.q2 ORDER BY t.driverid ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.number FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017 AND NOT q.q3 IS NULL AND q.q3 <> '' AND q.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q2.q3) FROM qualifying AS q2 JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceid = q2.raceid WHERE r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r2.year = 2017 AND NOT q2.q3 IS NULL AND q2.q3 <> '')

SELECT t2.code, t1.q3 FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix') AND t1.q3 <> '' AND t1.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM qualifying WHERE raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix') AND q3 <> '')

SELECT d.nationality FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q3 IS NULL AND q.q3 <> '' AND q.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q2.q3) FROM qualifying AS q2 JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceid = q2.raceid WHERE r2.year = 2017 AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q2.q3 IS NULL AND q2.q3 <> '')

SELECT r.year, res.time AS runner_up_gap FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND res.positionorder = 2 AND NOT r.time IS NULL AND r.time = (SELECT MIN(r2.time) FROM races AS r2 WHERE r2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r2.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND NOT r2.time IS NULL) ORDER BY r.year DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT d.code FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NOT q.q3 IS NULL AND q.q3 <> '' ORDER BY d.code NULLS FIRST

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time AS finish_time FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceid = r.raceid AND res.positionorder = 1 JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND CAST(r.time AS TIME) <= TIME '17:00' ORDER BY r.year NULLS FIRST

WITH mark(t) AS (SELECT '1' || ':' || '38.000') SELECT d.number, d.surname FROM qualifying AS q INNER JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND CAST(q.q3 AS TEXT) LIKE '%:%' AND q.q3 < (SELECT t FROM mark) ORDER BY d.number NULLS FIRST

WITH per_circuit AS (SELECT c.circuitref AS circuitref, MIN(CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(r.time AS TIME))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(r.time AS TIME))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) AS earliest_start_seconds, MAX(CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(r.time AS TIME))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(r.time AS TIME))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END) AS latest_start_seconds FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE NOT r.time IS NULL GROUP BY c.circuitref) SELECT STRING_AGG(circuitref, ', ') AS earliest_circuitref, (SELECT STRING_AGG(circuitref, ', ') FROM per_circuit WHERE latest_start_seconds = (SELECT MAX(latest_start_seconds) FROM per_circuit)) AS latest_circuitref, (SELECT MAX(latest_start_seconds) - MIN(earliest_start_seconds) FROM per_circuit) AS gap_seconds FROM per_circuit WHERE earliest_start_seconds = (SELECT MIN(earliest_start_seconds) FROM per_circuit)

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(d.dob AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990' AND NOT r.fastestlapspeed IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN (r.fastestlapspeed) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((r.fastestlapspeed) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) DESC NULLS LAST, d.dob NULLS FIRST, d.surname NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

SELECT d.driverref FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017 AND NOT q.q1 IS NULL AND (q.q2 IS NULL OR q.q2 = '') ORDER BY q.q1 DESC NULLS LAST, d.driverid NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.driverid) AS num_withdrawn_drivers FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN status AS s ON s.statusid = x.statusid WHERE r.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1962 AND s.status = 'Withdrew'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT x.position IS NULL THEN x.driverid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT x.driverid), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS finisher_percentage FROM races AS r JOIN results AS x ON x.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'

WITH per_event AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(e.cost) AS event_spend FROM expense AS e JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah' AND m.last_name = 'Allen' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(e.expense_date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 2) IN ('09', '10') AND NOT b.link_to_event IS NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(event_spend) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM per_event

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(t1.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019' THEN t2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(t1.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2020' THEN t2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS t1 INNER JOIN budget AS t2 ON t1.event_id = t2.link_to_event
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN t2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM budget AS t1 INNER JOIN event AS t2 ON t1.link_to_event = t2.event_id WHERE t1.category = 'Advertisement' AND t2.type = 'Meeting'

WITH ratios AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, CAST(SUM(b.spent) AS DECIMAL(20, 4)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0), 0) AS ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Closed' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 0) SELECT event_name FROM ratios WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM ratios)

SELECT t1.first_name, t1.last_name FROM member AS t1 INNER JOIN attendance AS t2 ON t1.member_id = t2.link_to_member GROUP BY t2.link_to_member, t1.first_name, t1.last_name HAVING COUNT(t2.link_to_event) > 7

SELECT DISTINCT t3.first_name, t3.last_name, t3.phone FROM expense AS t1 INNER JOIN budget AS t2 ON t1.link_to_budget = t2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS t3 ON t3.member_id = t1.link_to_member WHERE t1.cost > (SELECT AVG(t1.cost) FROM expense AS t1 INNER JOIN budget AS t2 ON t1.link_to_budget = t2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS t3 ON t3.member_id = t1.link_to_member)

WITH fall_events AS (SELECT e.event_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance AS a WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS attendees FROM event AS e WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'), agg AS (SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(attendees) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_att FROM fall_events), soccer AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS head_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') SELECT s.head_count AS soccer_attendance, g.avg_att AS average_attendance, CASE WHEN s.head_count > g.avg_att THEN 'more' WHEN s.head_count < g.avg_att THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS verdict FROM soccer AS s CROSS JOIN agg AS g

SELECT m.department, COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_id) AS majors_offered, COUNT(DISTINCT mem.link_to_major) AS majors_held, ROUND(CAST(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT mem.member_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_members_per_major FROM major AS m LEFT JOIN member AS mem ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' GROUP BY m.department

SELECT e.type AS event_type, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e2 ON e2.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e2.type = e.type AND SUBSTRING(CAST(e2.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019') AS members_who_attended, CASE WHEN (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e3 ON e3.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e3.type = e.type AND SUBSTRING(CAST(e3.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019'), 0)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e3 ON e3.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e3.type = e.type AND SUBSTRING(CAST(e3.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019'), 0)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS total_budgeted FROM event AS e WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(e.event_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2019' GROUP BY e.type ORDER BY e.type NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.department, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues_received FROM major AS m LEFT JOIN member AS mb ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id AND mb.position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN income AS i ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id AND i.source = 'Dues' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attendance AS a WHERE a.link_to_member = mb.member_id) WHERE m.college IN (SELECT college FROM major WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') GROUP BY m.department ORDER BY m.department NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(b.remaining) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS remaining_total FROM member AS m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget FROM expense WHERE cost > 50) AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY remaining_total DESC NULLS LAST, m.last_name ASC NULLS FIRST, m.first_name ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues FROM income AS i WHERE i.source = 'Dues' AND i.link_to_member IN (SELECT a.link_to_member FROM attendance AS a INNER JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors_without_members FROM major AS m WHERE m.college = (SELECT t2.college FROM member AS t1 INNER JOIN major AS t2 ON t1.link_to_major = t2.major_id WHERE t1.first_name = 'Tyler' AND t1.last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM member AS mm WHERE mm.link_to_major = m.major_id)

WITH att AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS members FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(COALESCE(att.members, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_attendance FROM event AS t1 INNER JOIN budget AS t2 ON t2.link_to_event = t1.event_id AND t2.category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN att ON att.link_to_event = t1.event_id

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attended FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type = 'Budget' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location

WITH cnt AS (SELECT mj.major_name AS major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendees FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN major AS mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY mj.major_id, mj.major_name) SELECT major_name, attendees FROM cnt WHERE attendees = (SELECT MAX(attendees) FROM cnt) ORDER BY major_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM member AS mem WHERE mem.link_to_major = m.major_id))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM member AS mem WHERE mem.link_to_major = m.major_id))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage

WITH t AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS cnt FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN t.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN t.cnt END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS officer_avg, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT t.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN t.cnt END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS other_students_avg FROM t

WITH RECURSIVE over_budget_events AS (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM budget WHERE amount - spent < 0), purchases AS (SELECT ex.expense_description AS d FROM expense AS ex JOIN budget AS b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM over_budget_events)), items(item, rest) AS (SELECT TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(d || ',' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN d || ',') - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(d || ',' AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN d || ',') + 1) FROM purchases UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1) FROM items WHERE rest <> '') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(item)) AS kinds FROM items WHERE item <> ''

WITH water AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE CAST(e.expense_description AS TEXT) ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY b.link_to_event), att AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT ev.event_name, ROUND(CAST((COALESCE(w.total_cost, 0) * 1.0) / NULLIF(a.attendees, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS water_cost_per_attendee FROM event AS ev JOIN att AS a ON a.event_id = ev.event_id LEFT JOIN water AS w ON w.event_id = ev.event_id GROUP BY ev.event_id, ev.event_name, a.attendees, w.total_cost ORDER BY ev.event_name NULLS FIRST

WITH flag AS (SELECT m.member_id, CASE WHEN b.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_college FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN major AS b ON m.link_to_major = b.major_id) SELECT SUM(in_college) AS members_in_college, COUNT(*) - SUM(in_college) AS members_not_in_college FROM flag

WITH chip_events AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id FROM budget AS b INNER JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE CAST(x.expense_description AS TEXT) LIKE '%chips%') SELECT e.event_name FROM event AS e INNER JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM chip_events) AND b.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM chip_events))

SELECT e.expense_date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM expense AS e JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE m.position = 'Vice President' AND e.expense_date = (SELECT MAX(e2.expense_date) FROM expense AS e2 JOIN member AS m2 ON m2.member_id = e2.link_to_member WHERE m2.position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY e.expense_date

SELECT e.type AS event_category, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attended_members FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY e.type

WITH cnt AS (SELECT mj.college AS college, COUNT(DISTINCT mj.major_id) AS majors FROM member AS m JOIN major AS mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY mj.college) SELECT college, majors FROM cnt WHERE majors = (SELECT MAX(majors) FROM cnt) ORDER BY college NULLS FIRST

WITH RECURSIVE split(item, rest, loc) AS (SELECT '', x.expense_description || ',', e.location FROM expense AS x JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.amount > 40 UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1), loc FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT loc AS location, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS things_bought FROM split WHERE item <> '' GROUP BY loc ORDER BY loc NULLS FIRST

WITH pizza_events AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Pizza'), sept_events AS (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND event_date < '2019-10-01') SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(b.amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_budgeted FROM budget AS b JOIN sept_events AS s ON s.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM pizza_events)

WITH per_event AS (SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spent FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(total_spent) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_total_spent_per_event FROM per_event

WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) AS total_spending, SUM(amount) AS total_budget FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), items AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(LENGTH(CAST(x.expense_description AS TEXT)) - LENGTH(CAST(REPLACE(x.expense_description, ',', '') AS TEXT)) + 1) AS purchases FROM expense AS x JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget GROUP BY b.link_to_event) SELECT e.event_name FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget_totals AS bt ON bt.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN items AS i ON i.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND (bt.total_budget IS NULL OR bt.total_spending <= bt.total_budget) GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(i.purchases), 0) DESC NULLS LAST, e.event_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH member_counts AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, members FROM member_counts WHERE members = (SELECT MAX(members) FROM member_counts) ORDER BY event_type NULLS FIRST

WITH RECURSIVE items(expense_id, item, rest) AS (SELECT e.expense_id, '', e.expense_description || ',' FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE b.category = 'Food' UNION ALL SELECT expense_id, TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1) FROM items WHERE rest <> '') SELECT item AS item_name, COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS record_count FROM items WHERE item <> '' GROUP BY item ORDER BY record_count DESC NULLS LAST, item NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE split AS (SELECT link_to_budget AS bid, cost, '' AS item, expense_description || ',' AS rest FROM expense WHERE approved = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT bid, cost, TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1) FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT s.item AS item, b.category AS category, SUM(s.cost) AS total_cost FROM split AS s JOIN budget AS b ON s.bid = b.budget_id JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE s.item <> '' AND e.event_name = 'October Meeting' GROUP BY s.item, b.category ORDER BY b.category COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST, s.item COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST

SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date, COALESCE(b.total_budgeted_amount, 0) AS total_budgeted_amount, COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS attendee_count FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budgeted_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event) AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id ORDER BY e.event_name ASC NULLS FIRST, e.event_date ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH RECURSIVE split(rest, item) AS (SELECT expense_description || ',', '' FROM expense WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison') UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1), TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)) FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT item, COUNT(*) AS times FROM split WHERE item <> '' GROUP BY item ORDER BY item COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST

WITH RECURSIVE split AS (SELECT link_to_member, expense_description AS rest FROM expense WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2019-11-30' UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest || ',') + 1) FROM split WHERE rest <> ''), items AS (SELECT link_to_member, TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest || ',') - 1) AS TEXT)) AS item FROM split WHERE rest <> ''), kinds AS (SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS kind_count FROM items GROUP BY link_to_member), spend AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending FROM expense WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2019-11-30' GROUP BY link_to_member) SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, k.kind_count, s.total_spending FROM kinds AS k JOIN spend AS s ON s.link_to_member = k.link_to_member JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = k.link_to_member WHERE k.kind_count = (SELECT MAX(kind_count) FROM kinds)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.major_id) AS different_majors FROM member AS t1 INNER JOIN major AS t2 ON t1.link_to_major = t2.major_id WHERE t2.department = 'Political Science Department'

WITH colour_counts AS (SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND c.colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY c.colour) SELECT eye_colour, hero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS popularity_rank FROM colour_counts ORDER BY hero_count DESC NULLS LAST, eye_colour NULLS FIRST

SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero AS t1 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS t2 INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id WHERE t3.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND t1.id = t2.hero_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS t4 WHERE t4.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND t1.publisher_id = t4.id)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2), SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id

WITH counts AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id) SELECT CASE WHEN marvel_count > dc_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' WHEN dc_count > marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END, ABS(marvel_count - dc_count) FROM counts
SELECT DISTINCT t1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND t2.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS ha2 JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') AND NOT s.full_name IS NULL AND s.full_name <> '-' ORDER BY s.full_name ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id AND s.eye_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN co.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id LEFT JOIN colour AS co ON co.id = s.skin_colour_id WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

WITH counts AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc, SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id) SELECT CASE WHEN dc > marvel THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN marvel > dc THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END, ABS(dc - marvel) FROM counts

SELECT AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS average_height_cm FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND s.height_cm > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp2 JOIN superhero AS s2 ON s2.id = hp2.hero_id JOIN publisher AS p2 ON p2.id = s2.publisher_id WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND hp2.power_id = hp.power_id))

WITH strength_heroes AS (SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength') SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count FROM superpower AS s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.power_id = s.id AND hp.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp2 WHERE hp2.power_id = s.id AND NOT hp2.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes))
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t1.weight_kg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t2.colour = 'Green' AND t1.weight_kg > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS neither_good_nor_bad FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment IS NULL OR NOT a.alignment IN ('Good', 'Bad')

WITH pc AS (SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS hero_count FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id JOIN superhero AS s ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND NOT s.full_name IS NULL AND s.full_name <> '-' GROUP BY sp.power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM pc WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM pc) ORDER BY power_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT abom_ha.attribute_value FROM superhero AS abom JOIN hero_attribute AS abom_ha ON abom_ha.hero_id = abom.id JOIN attribute AS abom_a ON abom_a.id = abom_ha.attribute_id WHERE abom.superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND abom_a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence')

SELECT g.gender AS gender, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count FROM gender AS g LEFT JOIN superhero AS s ON s.gender_id = g.id AND s.hair_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Blue') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id) >= 10 WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY g.gender ORDER BY g.gender NULLS FIRST

SELECT CASE WHEN (ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT ha2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS s2 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id INNER JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a2.attribute_name = 'Strength') AND s.weight_kg > 0

WITH top10 AS (SELECT id FROM superhero ORDER BY height_cm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t3.power_name) AS superpowers FROM top10 JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON top10.id = t2.hero_id JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS character_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND (race_id IS NULL OR race_id = (SELECT id FROM race WHERE race = '-'))

WITH power_counts AS (SELECT s.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id) AS power_count FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal' AND g.gender = 'Male') SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(power_count) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_superpowers FROM power_counts

WITH sharers AS (SELECT DISTINCT hp2.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp1 JOIN hero_power AS hp2 ON hp2.power_id = hp1.power_id WHERE hp1.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Cryokinesis'))), counts AS (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hero_power WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM sharers) GROUP BY hero_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(cnt) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_superpower_count FROM counts

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END)) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND s.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT s2.eye_colour_id FROM superhero AS s2 JOIN publisher AS p2 ON s2.publisher_id = p2.id WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN height_cm > 0 THEN height_cm END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_height_cm FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')

SELECT AVG(CAST(t1.weight_kg AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN race AS t2 ON t1.race_id = t2.id WHERE t1.weight_kg > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM superhero AS t3 INNER JOIN gender AS t4 ON t3.gender_id = t4.id WHERE t3.race_id = t2.id AND t4.gender = 'Female')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.publisher_id) AS publisher_count FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id WHERE t1.height_cm > 200 AND t2.publisher_name <> ''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN alignment AS t2 ON t1.alignment_id = t2.id WHERE t2.alignment = 'Good' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS t3 WHERE t3.id = t1.publisher_id AND t3.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.weight_kg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_weight_kg, COUNT(*) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND s.weight_kg > 0

WITH blk AS (SELECT publisher_id AS pid FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf') SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS m WHERE m.publisher_id = (SELECT pid FROM blk) AND m.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT d.eye_colour_id FROM superhero AS d WHERE NOT d.publisher_id IS NULL AND d.publisher_id <> (SELECT pid FROM blk))

WITH counts AS (SELECT r.race AS race, COUNT(*) AS hero_count FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND r.race <> '-' GROUP BY r.id, r.race) SELECT race, hero_count FROM counts WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM counts)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(weight_kg) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE gender_id = (SELECT id FROM gender WHERE gender = 'Female') AND weight_kg > 0

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(v) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_intelligence FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t1.id, t4.attribute_value AS v FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS t4 ON t4.hero_id = t1.id INNER JOIN attribute AS t5 ON t4.attribute_id = t5.id WHERE t3.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') AND t5.attribute_name = 'Intelligence') AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Male' THEN COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Male' THEN COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_superpowers_male, ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_superpowers_female FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hero_power GROUP BY hero_id) AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id WHERE CAST(s.full_name AS TEXT) LIKE '% %'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN t1.height_cm > 0 THEN t1.height_cm END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_height_cm, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN t1.weight_kg > 0 THEN t1.weight_kg END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_weight_kg FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN alignment AS t2 ON t1.alignment_id = t2.id INNER JOIN colour AS t3 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t3.id WHERE t2.alignment = 'Bad' AND t3.colour = 'Green'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm > 0 THEN s.height_cm END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_height_cm, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.height_cm) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_height_cm FROM superhero AS s WHERE s.height_cm > 0 AND s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man') AND s.id IN (SELECT hp2.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp2 WHERE hp2.power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM hero_power WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')))

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END)) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id INNER JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad' AND c.colour = 'Green' AND sp.power_name = 'Flight'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.weight_kg) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND a.alignment = 'Good' AND s.weight_kg > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id WHERE g.gender = 'Male' AND s.weight_kg > 0 AND s.weight_kg < 70

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE r.race = 'Human' AND s.height_cm = (SELECT MIN(x.height_cm) FROM superhero AS x INNER JOIN race AS y ON x.race_id = y.id WHERE y.race = 'Human' AND x.height_cm > 0)

SELECT MAX(cnt) AS power_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(hp.power_id) AS cnt FROM superhero AS h LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id WHERE h.weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY h.id) AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_heroes_with_known_full_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN alignment AS t2 ON t1.alignment_id = t2.id WHERE t2.alignment = 'Neutral' AND NOT t1.full_name IS NULL AND t1.full_name <> '-'

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS h ON h.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = h.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND h.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(h2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS h2 JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = h2.attribute_id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed') AND NOT s.full_name IS NULL AND s.full_name <> '-' ORDER BY s.superhero_name NULLS FIRST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.eye_colour_id AS eid FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN colour AS h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id WHERE h.colour = 'Brown') SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.colour <> 'Brown' THEN 1 END) AS heroes FROM cohort AS t INNER JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = t.eid LEFT JOIN superhero AS s ON s.eye_colour_id = t.eid LEFT JOIN colour AS h ON h.id = s.hair_colour_id GROUP BY c.colour ORDER BY heroes DESC NULLS LAST, eye_colour NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN t3.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN t3.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN alignment AS t3 ON t1.alignment_id = t3.id WHERE t2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND NOT t1.full_name IS NULL AND t1.full_name <> '-'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS good_percentage FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(weight_kg) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND weight_kg > 0 AND id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM hero_power WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')))

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN co.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN co.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS co ON co.id = s.eye_colour_id WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) FROM patient AS p WHERE (p.sex = 'M' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.ua > 8.0)) OR (p.sex = 'F' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.ua > 6.5))

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(l.alb AS DECIMAL(10, 4))) AS DECIMAL), 4) FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE l.plt > 400 AND (CAST((',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.diagnosis, ''), CHR(13), ','), CHR(10), ','), CHR(29), ','), CHR(11), ','), '  ', ','), ' ', '') || ',') AS TEXT) LIKE '%,SLE,%' OR CAST((',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.diagnosis, ''), CHR(13), ','), CHR(10), ','), CHR(29), ','), CHR(11), ','), '  ', ','), ' ', '') || ',') AS TEXT) LIKE '%,SLE(%') AND p.sex = 'F'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient AS p WHERE p.birthday < '1976-10-09' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.tg >= 200)

SELECT p.id, p.sex, (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST('2026-10-09' AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS DECIMAL(4, 0)) - CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS DECIMAL(4, 0)) - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST('2026-10-09' AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) < SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age FROM patient AS p WHERE NOT p.birthday IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.glu >= 180 AND l."T-CHO" < 250) ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.id, (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST('2026-10-09' AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS DECIMAL(4, 0)) - CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) AS DECIMAL(4, 0)) - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST('2026-10-09' AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) < SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age FROM patient AS p JOIN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE hct >= 52 GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS qualified ON qualified.id = p.id WHERE NOT p.birthday IS NULL ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM patient AS p WHERE p.birthday < '1971-10-09' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.pt >= 14)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE CAST(l.crp AS TEXT) LIKE '%+' AND p.description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient AS p WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.sc170 IN ('negative', '0')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id = p.id AND NOT e.symptoms IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM patient WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory)

SELECT t2."T-BIL", t2.date, t1.id, t1.sex, t1.birthday FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM laboratory) AND t2."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM laboratory WHERE CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM laboratory))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p WHERE p.birthday > '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND NOT l.rnp IS NULL AND l.rnp <> 'negative' AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 10)

WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT t1.id FROM patient AS t1 JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.admission = '-' AND NOT t2.ssa IS NULL AND NOT t2.ssa IN ('negative', '0')), titers AS (SELECT t.id, t.rnp FROM laboratory AS t JOIN cohort AS c ON t.id = c.id WHERE NOT t.rnp IS NULL AND t.rnp <> 'negative') SELECT DISTINCT id, rnp FROM titers WHERE CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM titers)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 WHERE t1.diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400) AND t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 5)

SELECT p.sex, ROUND(CAST(AVG(COALESCE(c.n_dates, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_lab_test_dates FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS n_dates FROM laboratory GROUP BY id) AS c ON c.id = p.id WHERE p.sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination WHERE examination.id = p.id) GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT p.id, l.date, l.dna AS anti_dna FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND p.admission = '+' AND NOT l.dna IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (l.dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (l2.dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l2.dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM laboratory AS l2 JOIN patient AS p2 ON p2.id = l2.id WHERE p2.sex = 'F' AND p2.admission = '+' AND NOT l2.dna IS NULL) ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.admission AS care_setting, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patients FROM patient AS p WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 16) GROUP BY p.admission ORDER BY p.admission COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST

WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND (l.hct >= 52 OR l.hct <= 29)) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patient_count FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id IN (SELECT id FROM cohort) AND NOT l.rnp IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 16

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) AS highest_anti_ribonuclear_protein_value FROM laboratory AS l INNER JOIN patient AS p ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_normal_platelet_result, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_normal_platelet_result FROM patient AS p WHERE LENGTH(CAST(LOWER(REPLACE(p.diagnosis, ' ', '')) AS TEXT)) - LENGTH(CAST(REPLACE(LOWER(REPLACE(p.diagnosis, ' ', '')), ',', '') AS TEXT)) = 1 AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(REPLACE(p.diagnosis, ' ', '')), 'ra', ''), 'sjs', ''), ',', '') = ''

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(l.tp - 8.5) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS avg_tp_deviation FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND l.tp > 8.5 AND p.id IN (SELECT id FROM examination WHERE CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT) LIKE '%SLE%')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP)) >= '1960' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP)) >= '1960' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS percentage FROM patient WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT))) = 'psoriatic arthritis'

SELECT t1.sex AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t2.alb < 3.5 AND t1.sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY t1.sex ORDER BY t1.sex NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 64) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 64) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pct FROM patient AS p WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND NOT l.rnp IS NULL)

SELECT AVG(CAST('1999' - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS average_age FROM patient WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4') OR CASE WHEN (REPLACE("U-PRO", '>=', '')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((REPLACE("U-PRO", '>=', '')) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 300)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.sex = 'F' THEN t1.id END) AS women, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.sex = 'M' THEN t1.id END) AS men FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 32

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t2.date AS TIMESTAMP)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) AS youngest_age FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 64

SELECT COUNT(l.id) AS total_tests, SUM(CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_test_patients FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE LOWER(p.diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS patient_count FROM examination WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND thrombosis > 0

WITH episodes AS (SELECT e.symptoms FROM examination AS e JOIN patient AS p ON e.id = p.id WHERE POSITION('SLE' IN p.diagnosis) > 0 AND e.thrombosis > 0) SELECT symptoms FROM episodes GROUP BY symptoms HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM episodes GROUP BY symptoms) AS __photo_derived_1) ORDER BY symptoms NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT) LIKE '%SLE%' THEN id END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT) LIKE '%SLE%' THEN id END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM examination WHERE thrombosis > 0

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(gap) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS average_days FROM (SELECT t1.id, MIN((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(t3."Examination Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400.0)) - (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(t1."First Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400.0) AS gap FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN examination AS t3 ON t1.id = t3.id WHERE CAST(t1.admission AS TEXT) LIKE '%+%' GROUP BY t1.id) AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.got < 60 AND l.date BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31' AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT p.id, CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) < SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST(p.birthday AS CHAR(10)) AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age FROM patient AS p WHERE NOT p.birthday IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.ldh > 600 AND l.ldh < 800 AND CASE WHEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(l."U-PRO" AS TEXT), '>', ''), '=', '')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(l."U-PRO" AS TEXT), '>', ''), '=', '')) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 300) ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women_minus_men FROM patient WHERE diagnosis = 'RA' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE un < 30)

SELECT p.sex AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.cre >= 1.5 THEN p.id END) AS out_of_range_patients, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_patients, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.cre >= 1.5 THEN p.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS share_pct FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY p.sex ORDER BY p.sex NULLS FIRST

SELECT l."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO", p.admission AS status, p.id FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id JOIN (SELECT p2.admission AS adm, MAX(l2."T-CHO") AS mx FROM patient AS p2 JOIN laboratory AS l2 ON l2.id = p2.id WHERE p2.admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY p2.admission) AS t ON t.adm = p.admission AND t.mx = l."T-CHO" ORDER BY CASE p.admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END NULLS FIRST, p.id NULLS FIRST
