SELECT DISTINCT t1.id, t2.rnp FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1."First Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1991' AND NOT t2.rnp IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p."First Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1991' AND NOT l.rnp IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(hct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_hematocrit FROM laboratory WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1991' AND CASE WHEN (REPLACE("U-PRO", '>=', '')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((REPLACE("U-PRO", '>=', '')) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 300

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.admission = '+' THEN t1.id END) AS admitted_to_hospital, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.admission = '-' THEN t1.id END) AS followed_at_outpatient_clinic FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND CASE WHEN (t2."U-PRO") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2."U-PRO") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 30

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 WHERE t1.admission = '-' AND t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE ra IN ('-', '+-')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id = t1.id AND (e.kct = '+' OR e.rvvt = '+' OR e.lac = '+'))

WITH lab AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS lastdate FROM laboratory GROUP BY id), last_sc AS (SELECT s.id AS id, s.sc170 AS sc170 FROM laboratory AS s WHERE NOT s.sc170 IS NULL AND s.date = (SELECT MAX(s2.date) FROM laboratory AS s2 WHERE s2.id = s.id AND NOT s2.sc170 IS NULL)) SELECT l.id FROM lab AS l JOIN last_sc AS c ON c.id = l.id WHERE l.lastdate > '1997-01-01' AND c.sc170 IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY l.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE NOT ssa IS NULL AND NOT ssa IN ('negative', '0')) AND t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE NOT "U-PRO" IS NULL AND NOT "U-PRO" IN ('-', '0'))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN (t2.dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END < 8
SELECT COUNT(*) AS admitted_never_high_alp FROM patient WHERE admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory WHERE laboratory.id = patient.id AND alp >= 300)

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) AS max_rnp_level FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t2.cre < 1.5

SELECT CASE p.sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS severe_anemia_patients FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE l.hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY p.sex HAVING p.sex IN ('F', 'M')

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM laboratory WHERE got >= 60 AND CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM laboratory WHERE got >= 60)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.birthday > '1980-01-01' AND ((l.fg < 150 OR l.fg > 450) OR (l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4') OR CASE WHEN (REPLACE(l."U-PRO", '>=', '')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((REPLACE(l."U-PRO", '>=', '')) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 300))

SELECT CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS patient_group, COUNT(*) AS normal_ldh_measurements FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-') AND l.ldh < 500 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY patient_group

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id) AS patients_with_lab_results, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN t2.id END) AS patients_with_elevated_bilirubin FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.sex IS NULL OR t1.sex = ''

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN examination AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE CAST(t1.admission AS TEXT) LIKE '+%' AND t1.sex = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t1.birthday AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1945' AND '1989' AND t2."ANA Pattern" = 'P'

SELECT p.id, p.sex, MAX(CASE WHEN (r.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((r.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) AS highest_level FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS r ON r.id = p.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS h WHERE h.id = p.id AND h.hgb < 10) GROUP BY p.id, p.sex HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN (r.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((r.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (r2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((r2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM patient AS p2 JOIN laboratory AS r2 ON r2.id = p2.id WHERE p2.admission = '-' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS h2 WHERE h2.id = p2.id AND h2.hgb < 10))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM laboratory WHERE id = l.id) AND l.got < 60 AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 10

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex AS sex, l.date AS most_recent_test_date, l."U-PRO" AS proteinuria_level FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE NOT l."U-PRO" IS NULL AND l.date = (SELECT MAX(l2.date) FROM laboratory AS l2 WHERE l2.id = l.id AND NOT l2."U-PRO" IS NULL) ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT t1.id FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t2.cpk < 250 AND t1.admission = '-' AND CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 4

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM examination AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 0 AND t1.thrombosis = 0

SELECT t1.birthday FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t2.gpt < 60 AND t1.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE CASE WHEN (rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 16) GROUP BY t1.id ORDER BY MAX(t2.gpt) DESC NULLS LAST, t1.id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS t1 INNER JOIN laboratory AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.sex = 'F' AND t2.pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN (t2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((t2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 16

WITH cand AS (SELECT p.diagnosis, CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l.date AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l.date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) < SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age, CASE WHEN (l.dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS level, l.date AS test_date FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE NOT l.dna IS NULL AND NOT p.birthday IS NULL AND p.admission = '+') SELECT age, diagnosis FROM cand WHERE level = (SELECT MAX(level) FROM cand) ORDER BY test_date NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.sex FROM patient AS p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT id FROM laboratory WHERE "T-BIL" >= 1.2) AND POSITION(',' || 'SLE' || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(p.diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',') > 0 ORDER BY p.sex NULLS FIRST, p.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS care_setting, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_rnp_at_least_4, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 4) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS patients_without_such_result FROM patient AS p WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND p.birthday <= CAST((CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - 50) || SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 5) AS DATE) AND p.admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY care_setting NULLS FIRST

WITH latest_igg AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS lastdate FROM laboratory WHERE NOT igg IS NULL GROUP BY id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p JOIN latest_igg AS li ON li.id = p.id JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = li.id AND l.date = li.lastdate WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.igg >= 2000

WITH ranked AS (SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.diagnosis AS diagnosis, l.dna AS highest_anti_dna, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN (l.dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END DESC NULLS LAST, l.date DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE CAST(p.diagnosis AS TEXT) LIKE '%SLE%' AND NOT l.dna IS NULL), best AS (SELECT patient_id, diagnosis, highest_anti_dna FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT patient_id, diagnosis, highest_anti_dna FROM best WHERE CASE WHEN (highest_anti_dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((highest_anti_dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN (highest_anti_dna) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((highest_anti_dna) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) FROM best) ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM laboratory WHERE NOT igg IS NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS care_setting, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.igg > 900 AND l.igg < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS patient_share FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN latest AS l ON l.id = p.id AND l.rn = 1 WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS maxdate FROM laboratory GROUP BY id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 32 THEN p.id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 32 THEN p.id END) AS female_minus_male FROM patient AS p JOIN latest AS la ON p.id = la.id JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = la.id AND l.date = la.maxdate

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS female_patients FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND NOT l.rnp IS NULL AND l.date = (SELECT MAX(l2.date) FROM laboratory AS l2 WHERE l2.id = p.id AND NOT l2.rnp IS NULL) AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 64 AND l.cpk < 250

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatients, SUM(CASE WHEN admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatients, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS inpatient_pct FROM patient WHERE CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT) LIKE '%SLE%' AND CAST(diagnosis AS TEXT) NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday FROM patient AS p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.ldh >= 500) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS u WHERE u.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) LIKE '%(%' THEN CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) FROM POSITION('(' IN u."U-PRO") + 1 FOR POSITION(')' IN u."U-PRO") - POSITION('(' IN u."U-PRO") - 1)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) FROM POSITION('(' IN u."U-PRO") + 1 FOR POSITION(')' IN u."U-PRO") - POSITION('(' IN u."U-PRO") - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END WHEN CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) LIKE '>=%' THEN CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) FROM 3)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(u."U-PRO" AS TEXT) FROM 3)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END ELSE CASE WHEN (u."U-PRO") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((u."U-PRO") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END END >= 100) ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST
SELECT p.sex AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patients FROM patient AS p WHERE p.sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id = p.id) GROUP BY p.sex ORDER BY p.sex NULLS FIRST
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("First Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) = '1998' AND sex = 'F' AND CAST(admission AS TEXT) LIKE '+%'

WITH target AS (SELECT 'SLE' AS d) SELECT e.symptoms, p.diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN examination AS e ON e.id = p.id WHERE NOT p.birthday IS NULL AND NOT e.symptoms IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(e.symptoms AS TEXT)) <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target WHERE REPLACE(',' || REPLACE(e.diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || d || ',', '') <> ',' || REPLACE(e.diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',') ORDER BY p.birthday DESC NULLS LAST, p.id NULLS FIRST, e."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p WHERE p."First Date" >= '1998-02-15' AND p."First Date" <= '1998-02-28' AND CAST(p.admission AS TEXT) LIKE '+%' ORDER BY p.birthday ASC NULLS FIRST, p.id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_acl_igm FROM examination AS e WHERE e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31' AND POSITION(',' || 'SLE' || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(e.diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',') > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(diagnosis, ' ', '')) = UPPER(REPLACE('Psoriatic arthritis', ' ', ''))

SELECT p.sex AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p WHERE p.sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.gpt >= 60) GROUP BY p.sex ORDER BY p.sex NULLS FIRST

SELECT p.admission AS care_setting, COUNT(*) AS patient_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST('2026-10-09' AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST('2026-10-09' AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.birthday AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM-DD') < TO_CHAR(CAST(p.birthday AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_age FROM patient AS p WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.rbc < 3.5) GROUP BY p.admission ORDER BY p.admission COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST
SELECT p.sex AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY p.sex

WITH RECURSIVE tokens AS (SELECT id, '' AS tok, COALESCE(diagnosis, '') || ',' AS rest FROM patient UNION ALL SELECT id, TRIM(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(',' IN rest) - 1) AS TEXT)), SUBSTRING(CAST(rest AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(',' IN rest) + 1) FROM tokens WHERE rest <> '') SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN e."aCL IgM" > 0 THEN e."aCL IgM" END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_acl_igm FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id IN (SELECT id FROM tokens WHERE tok = 'SJS')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS n_female_sjs_patients FROM patient AS t1 JOIN examination AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.sex = 'F' AND CAST((',' || REPLACE(t2.diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',') AS TEXT) LIKE ('%' || ',' || 'SjS' || ',' || '%')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.rnp IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.sm IN ('negative', '0')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id = p.id AND e.thrombosis = 0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM examination AS e WHERE e.id = p.id AND e.thrombosis <> 0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l."U-PRO") IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l."U-PRO") AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 30)

SELECT t1.id FROM patient AS t1 WHERE t1.admission = '-' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l1 WHERE l1.id = t1.id AND (l1.rbc <= 3.5 OR l1.rbc >= 6)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l2 WHERE l2.id = t1.id AND CASE WHEN (l2.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l2.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 0) ORDER BY t1.id NULLS FIRST

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 6) < SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_age FROM patient AS p WHERE (CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST('2026-10-09' AS TEXT) FROM 6) < SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 70 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory AS l WHERE l.id = p.id AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END >= 64)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND l.wbc > 3.5 AND l.wbc < 9.0 AND (l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN (l.rnp) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((l.rnp) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 15

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sex IN ('M', 'F') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS percentage FROM patient WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birthday AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM laboratory WHERE laboratory.id = patient.id AND laboratory.cpk >= 250)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4) BETWEEN '1981' AND '1986' AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND NOT p.birthday IS NULL AND (CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR 4)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'), '0') AS BIGINT) END - CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(l.date AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) < SUBSTRING(CAST(p.birthday AS TEXT) FROM 6 FOR 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 AND NOT l."U-PRO" IS NULL AND NOT l."U-PRO" IN ('-', '0')

WITH molecules AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-'), oxygen AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM atom WHERE element = 'o' GROUP BY molecule_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(COALESCE(oxygen.n, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) FROM molecules LEFT JOIN oxygen ON oxygen.molecule_id = molecules.molecule_id

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY b.molecule_id) AS per_molecule

WITH counts AS (SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS n FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element) SELECT element FROM counts WHERE n = (SELECT MIN(n) FROM counts) ORDER BY element NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.element = 'i' THEN t1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.element = 's' THEN t1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS t3 ON t2.bond_id = t3.bond_id WHERE t3.bond_type = '-'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM molecule AS m WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT b.bond_type, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST, b.bond_type NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT t2.bond_id FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id WHERE t2.bond_id IN (SELECT t3.bond_id FROM connected AS t3 INNER JOIN atom AS t4 ON t3.atom_id = t4.atom_id WHERE t4.element = 'p') AND t1.element = 'n'
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom AS a WHERE NOT a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected) ORDER BY a.element NULLS FIRST

WITH triple AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#'), hetero AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')), qualified AS (SELECT t.molecule_id FROM triple AS t JOIN hetero AS h ON h.molecule_id = t.molecule_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a JOIN qualified AS q ON q.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

WITH molecules AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 4) FROM molecules AS m JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH subquery AS (SELECT DISTINCT t1.atom_id, t1.element, t1.molecule_id, t2.label FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t2.molecule_id = 'TR006') SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END / NULLIF((CASE WHEN COUNT(atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(atom_id) END), 0) AS ratio, label FROM subquery GROUP BY label

SELECT (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) FROM molecule AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type <> '-')) AS diff_molecules_with_only_single_bonds, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) FROM molecule AS m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type <> '-')) AS diff_other_molecules

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_pairs FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '=' AND a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' AND c.atom_id < c.atom_id2

WITH plus_atoms AS (SELECT a.atom_id, a.element FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'), bonded AS (SELECT atom_id, element FROM plus_atoms WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) OR atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)), bonded_counts AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bonded GROUP BY element), top AS (SELECT MAX(n) AS mx FROM bonded_counts), all_counts AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS na FROM plus_atoms GROUP BY element), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS tot FROM plus_atoms) SELECT bc.element, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * ac.na / NULLIF(t.tot, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pct FROM bonded_counts AS bc JOIN top ON bc.n = top.mx JOIN all_counts AS ac ON ac.element = bc.element CROSS JOIN total AS t ORDER BY bc.element NULLS FIRST

SELECT t2.molecule_id, CASE WHEN t2.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS flag_carcinogenic, COUNT(t3.bond_id) AS multiple_bonds FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS t3 ON t3.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t1.atom_id = 'TR041_10' AND t3.bond_type <> '-' GROUP BY t2.molecule_id, t2.label

SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' AND m.label = '+' GROUP BY b.bond_type ORDER BY b.bond_type NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END) AS bonded_atoms FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.atom_id2) AS atom_count FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON t1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE t1.element = 's' AND m.label = '+'

SELECT t1.bond_id, t1.molecule_id FROM bond AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t2.label = '+' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = t1.molecule_id AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM atom GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_molecules FROM molecule AS m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'n') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a2 INNER JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a2.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.element = 'n' AND b.bond_type <> '-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count FROM connected AS t1 INNER JOIN atom AS t2 ON t1.atom_id2 = t2.atom_id WHERE t2.element = 'cl'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pct_carcinogenic, ROUND(CAST(CASE WHEN (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN b.molecule_id END)) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN b.molecule_id END)) AS TEXT) FROM '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?'), '0') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pct_non_carcinogenic FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

WITH rare AS (SELECT element FROM atom GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM rare) GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id NULLS FIRST

WITH carbonbonds AS (SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS carbon_bond_count FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'c' GROUP BY a.molecule_id), moleculestats AS (SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'c') AS carbon_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'cl') AS chlorine_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type <> '-') AS multiple_bond_count FROM molecule AS m WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c')), ranked AS (SELECT ms.molecule_id, ms.label, ms.atom_count, ms.bond_count, ms.carbon_count, ms.chlorine_count, COALESCE(cb.carbon_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds, ms.multiple_bond_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(cb.carbon_bond_count, 0) DESC NULLS LAST, ms.atom_count DESC NULLS LAST, ms.molecule_id NULLS FIRST) AS position FROM moleculestats AS ms LEFT JOIN carbonbonds AS cb ON cb.molecule_id = ms.molecule_id) SELECT position, molecule_id, label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_count, chlorine_count, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bond_count FROM ranked ORDER BY position NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE a.element = 'h' AND a.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'y')

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(cnt) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_bonds_per_atom FROM (SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt FROM atom AS a LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY a.atom_id) AS __photo_derived_1

SELECT a2.element AS element, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a1.element = 'c' AND b.bond_type <> '-' GROUP BY a2.element ORDER BY a2.element NULLS FIRST

WITH scoped AS (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377' AND bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY bond_type), pairs AS (SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END) AS pair_count FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY b.bond_type) SELECT s.bond_type, s.bond_count, p.pair_count, m.label AS molecule_label FROM scoped AS s JOIN pairs AS p ON p.bond_type = s.bond_type JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR377' ORDER BY s.bond_count DESC NULLS LAST, s.bond_type NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT t1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS t1 INNER JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom AS t3 ON t1.molecule_id = t3.molecule_id WHERE t2.bond_type = '-' AND t1.label = '-' AND t3.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') ORDER BY t1.molecule_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

WITH per_atom AS (SELECT a.atom_id AS atom_id, a.element AS element, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id AND b.bond_type <> '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS saturated FROM atom AS a) SELECT element, SUM(saturated) AS atoms FROM per_atom GROUP BY element ORDER BY element NULLS FIRST

SELECT a.element AS element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS n_molecules FROM atom AS a WHERE a.element IN (SELECT at.element FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS at ON c.atom_id = at.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#') GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY n_molecules DESC NULLS LAST, a.element NULLS FIRST

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT c.bond_id IS NULL THEN a.atom_id END) AS bonded_atoms FROM atom AS a LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY a.element NULLS FIRST
